Also, the coolant reservoir has been moved from the Stockpile Area to the Staff Lounge.

......

findings.name: Log with Messy Scribbles
findings.text:
............

Catastrophe struck without warning. The Blight ravaged the camp. Landbreakers emerged from the wastes like blades through smoke.

Since when did they grow bold enough to strike directly at UWST?

............

Olga isn't getting any better. I must save energy to keep her Supporter device going till we reach the shelter.

Pavel offered to help look after her, but I can tell he's barely holding on. He's too old to withstand this kind of torture.

............

We've met the rescue team! The one leading the team is a young man. You can tell he doesn't have much experience, but he's nice.

Olga's condition has finally stabilized, and we've also received a batch of supplies. Things seem to be starting to take a turn for the better.

............

In the morning, Noffman asked me if we should slow down, but I refused. The Blight is still spreading continuously, we can't rest now.

Olga and Pavel support my decision. The three of us are walking at the end of the team, looking out for each other. As long as we don't fall behind, everything will be fine.

............

findings.name: Neatly Written Investigation Notes
findings.text:
............

From the new leads provided by the Endministrator, there remains a chance the three missing souls yet live. No trace of their remains has been found to confirm their end. What's more, the Landbreakers that seized their equipment show no signs of having crossed blades with them.

I've drilled it into the patrols, scour every corner for even a scrap of clue about the three. Once things settled a little, I trekked back to where they vanished, combing the area again and again. Nothing. Not a single trace. The only spot left unplumbed is the Landbreaker hive, where those things swarm thickest. But… they couldn't possibly be hiding there. And I won't send the patrols in to play Russian roulette with their lives.

As time creeps on, their chances of survival grow slimmer than a thread.

............

Perhaps the only hope lies with the watchtower.

............

findings.name: Analysis of Suspect UWST Crew Mate Signals Emitted from Landbreaker-Occupied Territories
findings.text:
Written by: ■■■■■■

Collaborator: Valley IV Emergency Committee

Overview

During the deployment of the signal receiver for a full-area scan, the system picked up a fleeting anomalous signal at the edge of the Landbreaker's controlled zone, its frequency signature matching the auxiliary operation device carried by Olga, the missing UWST member. The signal, however, was extraordinarily faint, its characteristics persisting for a mere 0.7 seconds before vanishing entirely.

Detailed Analysis

Signal signature encoding: Highly consistent with the coding structure of the UWST's second-generation Support operation system, with a matching rate of 93.7%.

Source location: The suspected signal emanates near the mountain path junction of the northeastern Origin Lodespring in Valley IV. A hotbed for Landbreaker activity, the area is marked "impassable" on official maps - yet unrecorded minor rifts and natural passages weave through it, offering fleeting shelter for those in hiding.

Signal status: Initial analysis suggests this is either an equipment anomaly or an automatic transmission mechanism, not manually triggered. It appears to be a continuously emitted device signal, though its extreme faintness prevented the capture of sustained signature patterns.

Preliminary Conclusion

The device emitting this signal requires long-term maintenance. While there's no corroborating continuous signal, this detection result strongly suggests that at least Olga, among the missing workers, is still alive. It is recommended that an amplifier be installed to continue capturing the signal.

findings.name: Training Material: Dangerous Wildlife and Aggeloi
findings.text:
...The Aggeloi is on the other side of the spectrum. Their behavioral patterns are extremely different from those of wild animals. As mentioned earlier, creatures like manglerbeasts would not approach humans unless they are hungry or otherwise made extremely aggressive during mating season or in defense of their cubs. Aggeloi, however, will always actively seek to attack humans that enter their detection perimeter.

Following this logic, the Aggeloi should leave us alone if we avoid this perimeter. However, different Aggeloi have different detection perimeters and it is impossible to get a precise measurement in the field. Nevertheless, we could gather enough data by observing Aggelos specimens...

(There are lines of handwritten notes below this chunk of text.)

The TGCC has compiled a chart of detection perimeter sizes of common Aggeloi and we have a copy of this. Make the numbers bigger and print them out for the students. I don't want them poking the Aggeloi for fun under the guise of scientific research. PEOPLE MIGHT GET KILLED!

The Sankta call themselves Angels but that's a Terran tradition and it means something else in the Lateran language. That's why we call the Talosian menace Aggeloi. Make sure the students are aware of these facts.

...To determine if an Aggelos is no longer threatening, the best indicator would be the presence of its halo. A badly damaged Aggelos with an intact halo can still absorb materials from the environment to "mend" itself...

...The top priority is to locate and destroy the Ankhor, then use specialized weapons to dismantle the physical structure of the Aggeloi...

...In the absence of weapons, construction tools should achieve similar effects...

(There are lines of handwritten notes below this chunk of text.)

For the next meeting, we should figure out a way to teach this section properly to the students. We can't let them think they can just slip out of base to fight Aggeloi for a handful of salt...

I suddenly remembered something about the Sankta who call themselves the Aggeloslaying Angels. Perhaps I shouldn't be too sensitive about the appropriateness of the names...

findings.name: Emergency Broadcast Log
findings.text:
[SUBJECT] ЭКОП

[SENDER] B071

[CONTENT]

.пересылать [заглавие 1001]

[заглавие 1001]

{

[SUBJECT] Emergency Broadcast

[SENDER] UWST

}

To all UWST sites in Valley IV:

WARNING! We are under attack!

The enemy comprises a large number of armed Landbreakers from the Bonekrusher Clann and a large host of Aggeloi.

We have multiple Ankhorfalls appearing above various UWST sites. This is no coincidence. We believe our enemy has a tech that allows them to control the Aggeloi.

All sites shall initiate our Security Contingency Plan at once!

All crew mates are to ready themselves. We are fighting more than one enemy!

*These texts have been sent to the inbox of all major UWST terminals within 7 minutes after the Valley IV Incident by a sender titled "UWST". The entire section is received by the ЭКОП (EKOP, Ursusian abbreviation of the Emergency Crisis Operations Broadcast) transponder of the UWST. Unfortunately, not every UWST crew mate managed to read this message.

*NOTE: We are unsure if the sending of this message occurred before or after the death of Agent Boris Petronov.

findings.name: Notes: Amateur Scientist
findings.text:
(A UWST leave application. Someone used the backside of the form to jot down a few notes.)

I saw it.

People walking with the Aggeloi. Organics and rockies doing their own thing without getting in each other's way.

I would have been super excited about this discovery. But said organics and rockies are killing my fellow crew mates!

No research or exploration of Aggelos behavior should ever be applied to such atrocities.

They probably need all the help they can get to rebuild the base, but I can't simply ignore this finding. They call themselves the Bonekrusher Clan. I must keep up with them.

Their knowledge of the Aggeloi may be enviable, but it is overshadowed by their disgusting abuse of this knowledge.

I'm sorry, director. I am gonna use up all my leave days.

(The leave application is signed by a crew mate named Aleksandr Abashin. The UWST informs us that they will help investigate the whereabouts of Mr. Abashin.)

findings.name: Eager Message
findings.text:
People should still get out and about.

Back when I was studying at the main campus, I pictured Wuling, such a crucial scientific developmental distrcit, as a concrete jungle of Research Centers. All steel, glass, and cutting-edge tech.

I never expected the natural scenery to be this beautiful too.

Classmates who've been to Wuling all say you can't miss the Stragglers Grove when you visit. But when you ask them why, they get all mysterious and can't really explain it...

Every major developmental district has its own specialty. I heard Wuling's strength is materials technology, with Xiranite as the flagship.
Could this grove hold something different?

Alright! Time for me to dig deeper!

findings.name: Memo: A Troubled One
findings.text:
Where was I just now...

And where am I now...

How do I get out?!

No wonder those jerks just laughed when I asked why visiting Wuling meant you had to see the Stragglers Grove!

............

A tough road indeed!

I took several transfers: first to the TGCC truck station, skipped the "flight" to save money, then switched to a burdenbeast line just to get here...

Am I really going to die in this grove right after arriving in Wuling?

............

But the most important life lesson is to learn from your setbacks.

I suspect the Stragglers Grove is also a place for students new to Wuling to train their mental fortitude. After all, with that Very Large Rift so close by, it'd be irresponsible to lack composure in an emergency.

Alright. Time to keep going!

findings.name: Memo: Junior Ranger
findings.text:
Control Panel...

What's it for again...?

Tianshi Pillar? Nah, couldn't be. They have different functions...

What's it called again? Some kind of "emitter" or something?

Emit what, water? No definitely not water...

Shouldn't have stayed up all night before class, but this is definitely equipment we won't need while patrolling the grove.

............

From the looks of it, it doesn't seem to be activated. That's not right. I'll report it later.

Even the slightest equipment damage must be treated with the utmost attention. First lesson in rookie training: an iron rule born from the North Wuling Exclusion Zone accident a decade ago.

findings.name: Memo: Troubled Sketcher
findings.text:
Burdosnout Hill is said to have gotten its name because its shape somewhat resembles a burdenbeast's nose.

Compared to the Zhailing Islet, it lacks that vibrant, living energy, and it doesn't have the dazzling beauty of the Gloomvale in full bloom. But this simple, quiet kind of beauty really captivates me.

After I finish painting the Eight Scenes of Wuling, maybe I should move here from New Wrankwood...

But I doubt Wuling City will expand out this far, it's too close to Qingbo Stockade. With all the calamities and conflicts, that clash with the Stockaders ten years ago ... the lives lost ... who's to say who was right or wrong?

I've also thought about moving to the Hongshan to paint the Hongshan Crater and mass drivers there. Such incredible sights...

Ah, forget it. I'll worry about the future when it gets here.

findings.name: Memo: One Who Took the Wrong Raft
findings.text:
...First the bamboo grove, now the bamboo raft.

I made it out of the Stragglers Grove, but I never expected the raft to be the next hurdle. Clearly, I got on the wrong one.

Where is this even...?

Getting to this area outside Wuling City, taking a raft is actually more convenient than riding a long detour by vehicle.

Plus, just riding a raft around and taking in the scenery ... it's nice too.

I heard Wuling spends a lot of effort every year maintaining the safety of the raft routes. Aggeloi must always be a lurking threat. Looking at the map, these raft lines aren't just to make local travel more convenient. They seem to serve defensive and patrol purposes too.

I suspect that if needed, each transport hub could form layers of defense. Quite sophisticated planning...

findings.name: Analysis: The Sword Quenching Book
findings.text:
............

"The Sword Quenching Book" explains the origin of the name "Sword Quenching Marsh" like this: a certain Tianshi once drew water from Jingyu Valley to temper a sword, testing its edge by slicing a peak. After the sword was forged, the water level in Jingyu Valley had dropped by five feet. Because of this, later generations named this shallow lake Sword Quenching Marsh.

............

As everyone knows, "The Sword Quenching Book" is only a few hundred words long, and the whole thing is notoriously obscure. One moment it's writing about a Tianshi forging a sword, the next it shifts to describing wondrous landscapes, Feranmuts roaming the skies, then moves on to Yan's scenery, Twelve Pagodas and Five Cities... I've only ever seen this kind of writing in one thing: encrypted texts.

Does "The Sword Quenching Book" contain some kind of hidden meaning? If that's really the case, what's the truth? Did someone create a giant weapon here over a hundred years ago, or build some special kind of water conservancy facility? Or is it just that some expert really used Originium Arts here?

............

findings.name: Angler's Ravings
findings.text:
The water here is deeper than elsewhere. There must be complex underwater currents around Zhailing Islet, or the lotus leaves wouldn't be moving.

Underwater currents, undercurrents ... perfect.

Plenty of oxygen, ample food, easy movement. This place is perfect for giants to thrive!

I'm gonna reel it in!

findings.name: Note Believed Left by a Landbreaker
findings.text:
These flowers, their color looks like hazefyre.

The hazefyre will spread here eventually!

Trust the boss!

A blessing! Glory!

findings.name: Ruins Researcher's Letters
findings.text:
Ten years, thirty major excavations... Master, I still haven't found anything.

I did think about giving up. I asked Songseekers at the Hannabit Circuit, trying to understand what their earliest masters glimpsed in that frozen desolation. I even asked the young ones at the Cabal, but found no answers.

How utterly despairing.

Back then, I felt that science, research, the history of Talos-II, Precursor technology... All of it, everything, was just a chaotic, hopeless "endlessness".

But my perspective later changed.

How do the people of Talos-II see us? How do they view HAS? Many believe we're always at the cutting edge of technology, and that's true. But most don't see us as lofty researchers floating above the clouds.

At a small pioneer settlement out in the wildlands, after they used an HAS device to purify a spring, their smiles made me realize: the greater purpose of HAS's technology and our research, is to help people live better lives.

You would know this better than I do. After all, during your most active era, HAS achieved the goal of supplying the vast majority of the Civilization Band's food.

............

Master, I will walk this path of research joyfully until the very end of my life.

Therefore, I humbly ask you to lower your gaze as well, and look toward the ground.

Also, Master, this time could you please not just reply with a single "Approved" and make me pay the postage?

findings.name: Memo: Sketcher
findings.text:
I heard about the "Treasure Grotto" last time I was in Wuling. They say Qingbo Stockade residents come here to scavenge for treasures.

Of course, calling them "treasures" is a bit generous. It's really just all sorts of supplies washed here by the currents.

Could be Aggeloi wreckage that sank who knows how many years ago, or maybe some special ore from the depths of the great river.

I looked around too, didn't find anything worthwhile.

The only somewhat interesting find was a few rocks. But how did the currents bring up stuff from deep underground? Unless those splatters grew hands and learned to use shovels?

findings.name: Partially Burned Note
findings.text:
............

Come to think of it...

............

You should come over to our side...

............

Some grudges just won't fade...

findings.name: Log: The Stockade Fin Catcher
findings.text:
Day before yesterday: 7

Yesterday: 5

These past few days, I've only managed to catch less than twenty fins. That's after scrambling all over Jingyu Valley, almost wandered right into the small patch where the Wuling folks farm.

Lately, everyone's been eating nothing but bamboo shoots, nymphsprouts, or various bits of splatters. I need to try harder. Can't let it get to the point where we're chewing on dirt and leaves.

The fins in the water, those little things are clever. They're experts at avoiding disaster. Hm. Does that mean something's about to happen in Jingyu Valley...?

findings.name: Grower's Log
findings.text:
Time flies. I've been in Wuling City for almost five years now.

Five years ago I was still in Qingbo Stockade, just digging bamboo shoots and catching fins, occasionally raiding supplies from Wuling City... Now I can seriously focus on studying agriculture. I guess that's pretty lucky.

Of course, I still can't really say whether life was better back in Qingbo Stockade or here in Wuling City.

............

They still can't let it go. On the surface, they live normal lives now, but I can tell there's still a fire burning inside them.

It might sound cowardly, but I just hope my old friends from the Stockade don't come ruin our fields. And of course, I hope Ruan Yi, Tangtang, and the others get a little less pressure on their shoulders.

findings.name: Message: Teacher's Warning
findings.text:
Even though Jingyu Valley isn't exactly remote, there's still a risk of Aggelos attacks here.

Went to eat at Pan's place. He said he's been running into more Aggeloi during his travels lately. Wonder if things will get worse here in Wuling too.

Ugh ... feels like the world's about to change again, doesn't it?

You kids have barely held a weapon. Be careful. If you run into danger, just run. If it gets bad, head to Qingbo Stockade for help. They won't just stand by and watch you get torn apart by Aggeloi.

findings.name: Tallykeeper's Log
findings.text:
This time, here's what we managed to get:

Nymphsprouts, canned pear x60

Hotpot base x40

Civilian-grade Yinglung Dagger x10

We grabbed a lot this time, and nobody got caught.

Out of the two who got caught last time, one stayed in Wuling. The other came back, still spinning the same old story.

The Wuling folks said they could teach him a proper trade, told him to "live an honest life" and "stop messing around out there."

If I got caught, what would I do?

Eat my fill and just stay in Wuling? Heard there's a whole street there full of food and fun stuff. Sounds great.

Go home?

Yeah ... perhaps go home. Our family's been in this Stockade since my great-grandfather's time. Home is here. I don't want to wander.

findings.name: Inspector's Hasty Notes
findings.text:
How big is this splatter? Twenty feet? Thirty?

The commotion's shaking heaven and earth. It's definitely not small.

Darkmask is a real fighter.

............

The question is, what kind of splatter is it, and how did it get in?

Is the water vein still secure?

Is there something wrong with the Ancestral Spring?

findings.name: Memo: Tianshi Pillar Array Daily Inspection
findings.text:
Inspector: XXX

Pillar 1: Normal.

Pillar 2: Normal.

............

Pillar 7: Unusual noise, surface damage.

............

Pillar 12: Insufficient Xiranite.

............

Daily Summary: The anomaly at Pillar 7 was likely caused by pebbles carried by beasts, while Pillar 12 had a minor issue with its sensor. Both have been repaired.

Note: I must admit I was a bit alarmed at first, as I thought there might be a problem with the Xiranite supply.

findings.name: Notes: Antique Enthusiast
findings.text:
The "Bell of Three Presences" represents the eyes, the hands, and the heart — symbolizing careful observation, diligent practice, and sincere dedication.

Absolutely marvelous. Is this a Yan antique? Could it be from Baizao, two centuries ago?

What other antiques are there in Wuling? I'd love to see them all.

It would be great if there were some ancient weapons around.

findings.name: Unfinished Review Draft
findings.text:
Flavor: 5/5. Absolutely perfect. Today I finally understood what it means for a scent to travel for miles and a spice to hit just right without being overwhelming. The moment I bit into the meat, the legendary Shangshu I'd only read about in books sprang to life before my eyes.

Ambience: 4/5. A little cramped, otherwise great.

Service: 5/5. Friendly and approachable, the staff are chatty but give you plenty of space.

............

What sets this place apart from all the other restaurants? It's the owner.

I only exchanged a few words with him, but I could tell he had traveled extensively across Talos-II.

When I saw "Morospolis-style Picked Greens" on the menu, I really thought it was just a gimmick at first. But the moment it was served, I knew the chef had truly mastered the soul of my hometown's cuisine.

As it turned out, Mr. Pan had indeed been to Morospolis. We spoke about the grand architecture and the warmth of people there... I felt homesick.

Food critics often say, "Taste a hundred dishes with your tongue, see a thousand people with your eyes." I think they were speaking of someone exactly like Mr. Pan.

findings.name: Martial Seeker's Log
findings.text:
The name "Sword Quenching Marsh" is steeped in legend. They say that ages ago, a Tianshi forged their sword here, cooling it in the lake and testing it by slicing through a peak, until the water level dropped by five feet.

I care little for the forging or tempering of sword.

What I truly wish to know is if Wuling harbors any genuine, profound swordsmanship.

I wonder if, in this lifetime, I'll ever have the chance to witness Chi Xiao.

I don't mean the clumsy tricks of youngsters, but the true mastery of a grandmaster.

Yet I truly have no idea where she might be.

findings.name: Morale-Boosting Message
findings.text:
My dear friends, Eureka is still a young brand — like someone barely twenty.

We must keep striving.

Look down. What you're wearing isn't just a random Eureka name tag. It's an iron core waiting to be forged into a shining medal. Every cup of tea we sell, every new customer age group we reach, brings that medal one step closer to brilliance.

Now, lift your heads and look up at Talos. Who are we really competing with? Brands like Shuzhou? No way. Forget them. Think bigger.

If humanity ever sets foot on Talos, we'll make sure the very first sip astronauts take carries the name of Eureka.

findings.name: Vigilant One's Inquiry
findings.text:
While I was patrolling Jingyu Valley yesterday, I spotted some marks left by weapons.

Giant crossbows and axes... They definitely belong to the Landbreakers.

They're not the same kind of trouble as Qingbo Stockade, and since they've actually come close to Wuling, we need to take it seriously.

It might bend the rules, but could we make an exception and deploy Yinglung this once?

We should concentrate our forces and eliminate the threat as efficiently as possible.

findings.name: Notes: City Doctor
findings.text:
Page 1=
How strange.

Several merchants traveling near the edge of Jingyu Valley reported a sudden burning sensation in their throats and observed smoke.

Upon inspection, their respiratory tracts were indeed damaged.

And their optic nerves were slightly affected...

Could there be new Aggeloi construct patterns?
|-|
Page 2=
Treatment isn't difficult.

But one patient exhibits marked mental agitation, while another is lethargic.

This is truly odd. Do toxic substances pick who they attack?

I've reported everything to the watchguards.

findings.name: Survey: Fangxing Avenue Expansion
findings.text:
............

The real challenge in expanding Fangxing Avenue lies in Wuling's overall expansion plan. It all comes down to how far the supply of Xiranite can extend. And tracing it further, to the capacity of Xiranite production.

With Tianshi Zhuang's trust behind us, we cannot afford to falter.

After the accident, Wuling was hanging on by a single breath. The city could easily have fallen silent.

For me, that breath was Fangxing Avenue, the very embodiment of vitality and a road to renewal.

Tianshi Zhuang saw this clearly. She focused on the essentials, and on the future. The plan she sent back to Hongshan Crater didn't succeed because of a single mall, or commerce alone. It convinced TGCC and legacy brands like Shuzhou for one simple reason.

It embodied people, routes, and the very promise of life.

We are the only ones daring enough to live and thrive on the Very Large Rift.

From the Science Station that once on it like thin ice, to today's flourishing city that links north and south... I must say, Tianshi Zhuang's vision is truly unmatched.

findings.name: Novice Runner's Message
findings.text:
I still can't keep up with the team.

But I keep asking myself: what really defines a runner's spirit?

It's perseverance.

Running is like life itself: keep going, and don't stop.

I must keep going and keep running.

findings.name: Chat Records: History Enthusiast
findings.text:
Q: You know, I'm really into history, and many things about Hongshan pique my interest. I've got some questions in mind. Take the name "Tianshi Bureau Academy" as an example, based on what I've found about Yan, why didn't they just call it "Tianshi Bureau"?

A: Back then, Hongshan Academy of Sciences (HAS) was founded under the Yan system as the "Affiliated Hongshan Academy of Sciences of Tianshi Bureau of Great Yan". Later, it expanded into five Scientific Developmental Districts, with new schools established in each. Naturally, they couldn't just call it "Hongshan Tianshi Bureau", since a subordinate unit couldn't just set up its own superior. That's why the Tianshi added "Academy" to the name, creating the "Tianshi Bureau Academy" — a new branch that remained under HAS's management.

Q: I see...

A: It's all about following the rules. The "Wuling Tianshi Bureau Academy" was set up temporarily with nothing more than a plaque on the District Office. "Guandai" literally means "acting in management." Back then, the Chief Reviewer Tianshi submitted all those reports to the imperial court, and they're still in the archives. Once the Cosmic Gate opens, they'll be sent to Terra.

Q: Wow, that's complicated! So there's a "Wuling Tianshi Bureau Academy" but no "Hongshan Tianshi Bureau"?

A: Right. But there is "Headquarters Tianshi Bureau".

Q: My head... Hasn't anyone ever used it incorrectly?

A: Plenty of people have! But as long as the rules are followed by those who matter, it's fine... No worries, just take your time.

............

Q: If I remember right, Materials Science is the strongest field at the Tianshi Bureau Academy, right? And Agronomy comes next? That's kinda surprising. I don't think I've ever heard of any big agricultural breakthroughs from there.

A: Tell me, since when has any of Hongshan's agronomy programs been weak?

Q: You have a point...

Q: So where do you learn your Thunder Arts? Is it a type of Originium Arts?

A: Wuling doesn't have a dedicated Thunder Arts program. People who want to learn it usually start from a young age. It's actually pretty easy to pick up, but hard to master. As for formal study, yeah, it's categorized under Originium Arts.

findings.name: Venerable Tianshi's Reminder
findings.text:
Aside from those from the HAS HQ, students from three other scientific developmental districts have already arrived in Wuling ahead of time to prepare for the exams.

Make sure their accommodations are well arranged. I've noticed many of them came for Materials Science, so let's organize a few tours of the Xiranite facilities and give them some proper introductions.

And make sure to remind everyone to stay well away from the Blight Tide. Also, keep tight control over the bamboo raft rentals.

findings.name: The Lovers' Messages
findings.text:
If you truly love me, go and fetch me a Chrysopolis Ingot.

I will also bring you an Effigy Stone.

I will fashion these objects, steeped in humanity's pain and hope, into our wedding rings.

They will stand as a testament to our journey together, until both our lives are woven into that long road, that endless sacrifice.

findings.name: Graduates' Discussion
findings.text:
............

Right now, it's the location I'm unsure about, not the project itself.

Although staying in Wuling would be nice, and Yinglung is certainly a highly desirable place, I still want to try sending my resume to Endfield.

............

C'mon! There's only one Dijiang, and who wouldn't want to hop aboard?

And even if you set aside Endfield Industries' contributions to human progress, there's still this: Romanticism! Sheer Romanticism!

findings.name: Agricultural Researcher's Discussion
findings.text:
............

Pumpkin farming is an excellent test project.

We're just a step away from restoring the technologies we lost, but it's always that last step that feels the hardest.

Sometimes I even wonder if those techniques truly existed. Did HAS really bring back practical, advanced techniques from Yan or Dahuang...?

Techniques like accelerated crop growth...

............

Anyway, I believe they're real. They have to be. One can't build a future on a new world without feeding its people first.

My conviction to seek the truth hasn't wavered.

My grandfather was a Landbreaker, and I grew up hearing his stories of hunger and fear.

That's why my wish is simple: I want everyone to have enough to eat.

findings.name: Memo: Researcher's Notes
findings.text:
Cooling and balancing...

The key to producing Xiranite is blending two elements together, and that's harder than it sounds.

It's a tough nut to crack.

And the real challenge is conversion efficiency.

Almost all the Originium from around the city has been funneled into Wuling, but the yield is just a trickle of Xiranite.

The UWST and TGCC are doing the best they can, but transport alone is a constant headache...

On top of that, everyone knows Originium loses activity at deeper levels, which only makes the UWST's Originium cultivation efforts less effective...

Honestly, it's harder than trying to distill Instant Vintage.

I should go grab a drink after work...

findings.name: Excited Students' Correspondence
findings.text:
BELIEVE IT OR NOT, I JUST SAW TIANSHI ZHUANG EXPLORING WULING WITH A STRANGER!

.........

Trust me, this isn't as simple as it looks. Everything might seem normal on the surface, but I can tell when someone has truly let their guard down.

Most of the time, Tianshi Zhuang seems encased in ice — the chill and tension around her making her feel remote and unreachable.

But when I saw her this time, it was as if that ice had finally started to thaw, even if only a little.

findings.name: Memo: A Dejected One
findings.text:
It's been over twenty years, and I think it's time I admitted it.

Studying just isn't something I can do.

I came to academy a few years ago, but my grades have stayed near the bottom ever since.

At this point, I can't tell if I'm just being stubborn or if I still believe in some goal out there.

Maybe it's better to think I still have a goal.

I want to explore the Ætherside. Maybe one day I will break the ban and enter it myself.

I imagine losing myself there, drifting through lands no human has ever touched, only to return from that secret domain countless years later.

Sounds almost poetic and dreamy.

Sigh, are grades really everything?

Anyone who goes into the Ætherside dies. Don't be ridiculous, kid.

findings.name: Memo: Weapons Expert
findings.text:
This gear batch designed for Yinglung might finally be ready for civilian adaptation.

But costs on making the Type 50 gear remain stubborn.

Converting this batch for civilian use is a headache ... just like Li's heavy gear...

findings.name: Sketcher's Confusion
findings.text:
I definitely saw a figure the other night.

Maybe it was a girl. She wore a cape and was drawing by the lake.

When I blinked, she was gone.

Has art already broken my mind...

Or was I actually witnessing art itself come to life?

findings.name: Tourists' Speculations
findings.text:
Engraved at the base of the statuettes were the phrases: "Wu as the pacifying force of martial might" and "Ling as the riparian ridge that denies the very Blight".

These statuettes look pretty old. Judging by the damage, let's say around twenty years?

I've heard that the name Wuling comes from these phrases.

I thought there was supposed to be four statuettes here.

Now there are just three here. Where's the fourth one?

Could it be in Qingbo Stockade, or was it destroyed in that accident?

findings.name: Today's Menu
findings.text:
Golden Sand Pumpkin

Pumpkin Pancake

Meat and Pumpkin Stew

I have no idea why they're so obsessed with pumpkins this year.

findings.name: Yan Ning's Concern
findings.text:
I'm really worried that giving up on the Xiranite flow control node is just the beginning.

With Xiranite production so slow, I wonder what facility will be cut next?

The city's water system? Or the academy's bell...

Wuling is sitting on the edge of a cliff... How can we pull it back...?

findings.name: Lost Item Notice
findings.text:
I've lost a package containing candy, a fountain pen, T-Creds, design drawing, and so on.

If you happen to find it, there's no need to return it.

Just take a moment to admire my genius design. Thanks.

findings.name: A Letter Home for the Researcher
findings.text:
Dear son,

All is well at home. Your mother and sister are well, so just focus on your work.

It may be the same old advice, but I still have to say it.

I have read the history of Wuling's founding. The Very large Rift remains a hidden danger. There are countless research projects across the cities. With your talent, you can always contribute elsewhere.

Also, we have an overabundance of pumpkins at home, so please do not send any more.

findings.name: Reprimanding Message
findings.text:
............

Did you really think I'd look down on you just because you were a Stockader?!

And what, you think I'd leave you? Where would I even go? Snatch a few Tianshi at the Academy gates and marry them?

Life isn't about running away! It's about making each day count!

............

You're the best farmer among us, so grow some confidence!

findings.name: Sketcher's Epiphany
findings.text:
............

Finally! The Eight Scenes of Wuling I've been searching for! This view is perfect, worthy of being painted and called a true masterpiece.

I don't even have to explain why this is perfect. Just a glance into the distance is enough to feel it. People toiling in the fields, sweat glistening as they work, and their smiles shining after the harvest.

I've never had any of these precious moments.

Perhaps this is what they call "home".

I think I may have already forgotten what "home" really is.

findings.name: Note Filled with Nostalgia
findings.text:
Another year has passed.

I know well enough that you perished in the exclusion zone. After we parted, you took on the mission, went into that place, and never came back.

Bugui Grove... Bugui Grove...

Our farewell has turned into a story, a place.

When my time comes, I'll join you, and together we'll live on inside that story.?

findings.name: Memo: Melancholy Tianshi
findings.text:
I come here whenever my mind feels heavy.

Just a lift of my eyes is enough to see the Blight spreading over the water.

From here, I can see the mounts lying shackled in ruin, the rivers chained in destruction. Merciless, icy death unfolds not far from me — strangely beautiful, as if it were meant to be this way.

Blight brings inevitable destruction. What fire must we kindle in our hearts to drive away its cold?

findings.name: File: Data Analyst Sync
findings.text:
The Tianshi Pillar on the outer side of the Stragglers Grove has suddenly lost signal, likely due to deliberate interference.

Ranger devices have also gone offline.

Requesting dispatch of watchguards to investigate the site.

Rangers have been contacted urgently.

Top-level alert is ready to be enacted. All outposts are synced and standing by.

findings.name: Machinist's Daily Inspection Log
findings.text:
Device Status: Normal

Device Temperature: Normal

Xiranite Reserves: Normal

Network Connection: Normal

Data Peak: Excessively High

Data Print Module: Normal

Daily Report: Hardware functioning normally. Potential software issue detected.

Note: Based on the latest Depth monitoring data of the Very Large Rift received this morning, no abnormalities were found. However, today's local readings seem unusual, as the Active Blight probability has spiked significantly. The printed charts almost suggest a moving rift circling around Wuling's perimeter. This is very odd indeed ... perhaps it's time to active the early warning system.

findings.name: The Watchguard's Advisory
findings.text:
Attention all merchants and transporters.

Reports indicate a Landbreaker group is heading toward Wuling. Do not leave the city for the time being; if you must, ensure you are properly armed and agile enough to protect yourself.

Advise from Wuling Watchguards: T-Creds are endless, life is not. Stay safe on your journey.

findings.name: Memo: Burdenbeast Handler
findings.text:
Fertilizer formula left behind by the Songseeker who departed yesterday.

Burdo-Muck:3 portions

Jincao Root:1 portion

Rakerbeast Muck:1 portion

Long-ear Muck:10 portions

Ferment for 20 days

According to her, this is the best fertilizer for the wildlands. It blends all kinds of manure into the richest compost of them all.

I was skeptical at first. Do people from the Hannabit Circuit really farm on the wildlands?

But she said her Aldertone specialized in farming...

I'm sure the Academy's custom synthetic fertilizers are probably more effective, but trying every old-school method you see is just part of the Hongshan spirit...

findings.name: Memo: Depot Guard
findings.text:
This area stores a large quantity of basic supplies like food. Stay alert during patrols, as it could be a prime target for Qingbo Stockaders.

Use your judgement: if the raiders are having a tough time, it's fine to let them off.

findings.name: Head Monitor's Complaint
findings.text:
Tangtang... Ugh, it's her again.

Can that kid please not blow holes in the walls next time?

If she weren't about my daughter's age, I would've gone out and roughed her up for Mi Fu.

Hmm, I got an idea.

I should drag her into school! She's young and capable, being illiterate is ridiculous!

findings.name: Memo: Stock Purchase
findings.text:
Purchase as many Chubby Lung as possible.

Check with the Bureau of Swordmancers to see if they have weapon kits for civilian vehicles.

Get photos of Wuling-specific Aggeloi.

Wuling's biggest shortfall is Originium. Everybody knows that Xiranite production has exhausted the Originium clusters around the city...

When will I ever get to participate in those big bulk trades...?

Maybe I should start by setting up a company after I get back.

findings.name: Martial Practitioner's Ravings
findings.text:
.........

Of course I know how dangerous the rakerbeasts are, but that's the whole point. You don't get stronger fighting weaklings.

I'll warm up with rakerbeasts, then take on quillbeasts, and then maybe skydrummers...

They're just beasts. I'm not gonna let them take me down!

I'm no weakling! I won't let one haul me off and chew me up!

findings.name: Excerpts from Catalog of Warriors Under the Heavens
findings.text:
.........

I was told that many masters meet their end on the battlefield, which sparked my curiosity. Since the end of the Second Aggeloi War, Talos-II has seen little large-scale battles, and tales of feats like "cleaving through hordes of Aggeloi" have long faded.

What, then, are the skills of today's masters, especially the younger generation?

I decided to find out myself.

.........

When I first arrived in Wuling, I met remarkable talents like Zhuang Fangyi, whose mastery of Lei Fa (Thunder Arts) is simply extraordinary. Unfortunately, she serves as Viceroy Tianshi, carrying heavy administrative responsibilities. Her strengths lie much more in management and research than in leading the charge on the battlefield.

After traveling for several days, I met the Captain of Pacified Skies, who declined my request to observe his swordsmanship. How I wish I could witness his earth-shattering power...

In the following days, I failed to track down Chen Chichi.

.........

Then, while following the supply convoy to the North, I missed the chance to see the promising young members of the Oathkeepers, as they were away on a mission. According to my Oathkeeper friends, several have emerged in recent years: some can march a hundred miles despite serious injuries, while others handle heavy armor and massive cannons as if they were light as feathers.

From afar, I also glimpsed Gerald "The Sanctified" Zasso. He may not be of the younger generation, but his legendary deeds have long been renowned throughout Talos-II.

.........

findings.name: Xiranite Horticultural Technique
findings.text:
(Version:145.221.2) The existing horticultural technique is limited by the Blighted environment; Xiranite's protective effect achieves only about 30% of the expected efficiency.

...

In this iteration, the Xiranite environmental regulation system underwent a comprehensive upgrade. Following redeoployment, its protective efficiency has increased to 90%, enabling potential crop growth even in surface regions under significant Blight Influence.

findings.name: Fertilizer Formula Flyer
findings.text:
I've come across a unique fertilizer formula from the Hannabit Circuit. Based on it, I've developed an improved version, and I'm happy to share it with everyone:

To make a fertilizer that keeps the soil fertile, mix Burdo-Muck with Liquid Xiranite and let it ferment for three days. The result is a rich, top-quality compost unlike any other!

Xiranite is hard to come by, and good muck's even harder. If you're looking to purchase high-quality Burdo-Muck, please contact me at: ████████████

Present this flyer during bulk muck trades to receive a one-time discount.

findings.name: Waterbell's Thoughts
findings.text:
When did all that admiration and affection begin?

Was it when he handed over that fowlbeast egg, or way back in childhood, with that silly joke about my height?

Seems like it was neither.

I don't know when it started or why, but from some day on, just seeing his figure would make me happy.

Geez, what a muddled mess.

Started in a daze, and ended in a daze without ever really doing anything.

He's been forever frozen in that rainy night, never growing older.

If I had been just a little brave, would things have been different?

If I had stopped him at the cost of my life, could I have kept him alive?

Ruan Yi, today I walked to the entrance of the stockade, wanting to see the world outside. But if I leave and spend a few decades out there, will I end up forgetting you?

But I don't want to.

Ruan Yi, I've always been kinda like this ... my thoughts are all jumbled up, pretty dumb, huh?

I never blamed you.

(The writing that follows is blurred by splotchy water stains)

findings.name: Memo: Raft Maintanance
findings.text:
So things have kinda cooled down between us and Wuling City now, huh?
Then shouldn't these bamboo rafts go back into Wuling City's transport system?
Ah ... don't even get me started. Since we snatched them back, I've been the one fixing them up all these years. Kinda grew attached, you know?

findings.name: Memo: Hurried Written and Delivered
findings.text:
How long must we hide?

Three days?

We'll starve to death. I say we hide till tomorrow. They'll definitely get themselves killed at Wuling. Then we'll jump into the underground river with our buckets and ride the currents to Sword Quenching Marsh.

GENIUS! But what should we do if they keep someone on the watch?

Distract them with fireworks!

What about the Blight...?

Then we'll pray to Lady Luck.

findings.name: Memo: A Loyalist's Final Words
findings.text:
That girl can be Tangtang, the Younger Dame, the Supreme Chief ... hell, she can just follow Mi Fu's lead, quit the Stockade, and be a watchguard.

She can have all that. I'm totally fine with it.

But I'll never forgive someone who murked Big Bro.

And since I do not forgive, I must do something.

No more escaping. We're settling this the Jianghu way.

I'll be standing right here. You blight-hearted Tangtang supporters can come at me all you want...

We'll settle this. One on one. To the friggin' death.

findings.name: Memo: Discouraged Stockade Resident
findings.text:
In the end, I couldn't make him stay. He left with the Landbreakers.

His heart was lost in that rainy night ten years ago, and no one could ever bring it back.

What is hatred?

Now it's my turn to be confused about all this...

Maybe hatred is just a beast's cage... Once a person is locked inside for too long, they turn into the beast, losing all sense of their true self, never able to return.

findings.name: The Sketcher's Eureka Moment
findings.text:
I finally see it clearly now.
I bet this winding bridge was originally some kind of barrier mechanism. At the very least, it definitely wasn't meant to be a walkway from the start. Otherwise, it'd be way too impractival...

The structure is "propped up" mid-air to minimize Blight damage as much as possible. Then, by using various barrier mechanisms, multiple lines of defense can be formed when Blight hits, keeping losses to a minimum.

What a brilliant design, making perfect use of the landscape and waterways... But the way it's being used now feels like this technology never got passed down.

These folks in the village... why do they all seem a bit slow?

findings.name: Memo: The Sketcher's Joy
findings.text:
Hah!

Can't believe it! The Eight Scenes of Wuling, I actually got to sketch this waterwheel!

Marvelous! Absolutely marvelous!

Heard about the trouble at Qingbo Stockade the other day and thought this place was gone for good...

Turns out nothing major happened, and everything's been handled really well. Total game-saver! That little girl chief is surprisingly capable, huh!

findings.name: Warning: From a Beast Tamer
findings.text:
Careful. This rakerbeast is a wild one. Locking it up does nothing to tame it.

Based on my family's knowledge of rakers, those with steel-like tails and lightning-keen eyes are the true sovereigns of their beasts. This one has the potential to rule them all.

Legends say that my ancestor tamed a raker with a blind left eye when he first arrived. The beast only listened to his command, fought along his side, and chomped splatters like dessert. The man and beast eliminated many threats when Qingbo Stockade was being built.

My ancestor treated it like family, but when he passed away, his "raker brother" left the Stockade that very night and disappeared into the grove.

And the raker we now have caged is probably a progeny from the legend from over a century ago. If I could tame it, this one would far surpass its own forefather.

findings.name: Memo: Fanning the Hatred
findings.text:
Hatred does not disappear.

Blood does not wash clean.

The dead do not forgive.

findings.name: Memo: A Sad Beast Tamer
findings.text:
Ugh, the poor raker died.

The beast was just too unlucky.

The empty cages did remind me of something else. I gotta look for raker cubs and see if I can catch a few.

I went through a few old books at home and learned that Qingbo Stockade once had pretty advanced beast domestication techniques. I finally learned what I was supposed to do.

Farming is meaningless. My duty is to tame the wild and ferocious elements of nature.

findings.name: Memo: Secret Code
findings.text:
Hey boss ... slipped out, my bad.

Chief already settled things with Wuling City, right? No need for us to keep using coded memos.

Hah, you might fool outsiders, but can you really keep it from Mi Fu

All these years, sneaking around with supplies - we all know how Wuling operates. They're willing to give us a way out, and we don't jack up prices to screw over our own people. That's why this supply line has kept stumbling along without breaking.

No need for that now.

Everyone, pack it up! From now on, we're doing business out in the open!

findings.name: Memo: A Traitor
findings.text:
Take out some of the trails to trap those cowards! But keep in mind that this is still our Stockade! DO NOT destroy everything!

Once we conquer Wuling with Big Bro, we'll return and build an even bigger and better and prettier Stockade!

findings.name: Memo: Vicious Words
findings.text:
Younger Dame doesn't deserve to live.

Unless Uncle Shang says so. Uncle's words are my command.

findings.name: Memo: A Schemer
findings.text:
Ruan's plan was definitely workable. Smashing Wuling's suppression of the rift and wiping the whole city off the map was undoubtedly the most efficient approach.

What a shame...that Darkmask was truly a master...

This plan still has some flaws, I've got a better one.

Wuling's canals are a tangled web. Blowing them up or infiltrating through them is the real winning strategy—way smarter than sending in our brothers blindly as cannon fodder to distract the city.

findings.name: Memo: The Guard
findings.text:
Ugh, I was hoping to lure out a few Landbreakers and squeeze some intel out of them.

Their so-called "boss", and that cane-wielding guy who showed up around Ruan... These people must still be hiding plenty of secrets...

The Marker Stone ... is that the original pillar in Wuling City?

The only Landbreaker I managed to grab killed himself ... talk about tight-lipped. These maniacs.

findings.name: Memo: The Training Fighter
findings.text:
I'll find him, Ruan.

I'm going to find that man with the cane.

It must've been him who did this to you.

I'm going to kill him.

findings.name: Memo: The One in Rage
findings.text:
Those reckless fools ... sigh...

Do you really think it's that easy to blend in with the Landbreakers? Choosing to run off with those incoherent maniacs?

Fine, go ahead and leave! But stealing a few bamboo rafts on the way out? Just go die in the water then! Heartless bastards!

findings.name: Memo: The Determined
findings.text:
If the bridge breaks, we'll build a new one! If the road's out, we'll fix it!

If people have grudges or bad blood, lay it all out from the start. Every single thing. Then, whatever needs to be let go of, let it go!

If you ask me, the Chief didn't do enough!

People have to move forward!

I'm moving forward whether anyone likes it or not!

Tomorrow I'm heading to Wuling City. Qingbo Stockade and Wuling City shall become one!

findings.name: A Kind Warning
findings.text:
Hey everyone, I've already started preparing the notices to put up.

On the notices, I want to write something like this.

"To all travelers, merchants, and others passing through Qingbo Stockade: if you encounter any difficulties on your journey, you are welcome to come to Qingbo Stockade for help..."

I haven't had much schooling, but after all we've been through, I think maybe we could all try to be a little kinder to each other.

We need to build a "bridge".

That way, at least the Chief will have a little less to worry about.

findings.name: Memo: An Instigator
findings.text:
Your crossbows and your Arts. None of them are strong enough.

Accept the hazefyre.

Accept the weapons wreathed in hazefyre.

Wuling is just the beginning...

The Baws ... shall let you witness the future.

findings.name: Note Hanging from a Bamboo
findings.text:
Protect my family

Safely en route

And safely home

Away from Tianshi captors

And free from Splatter attacks

findings.name: Crumpled Sheet of Paper
findings.text:
...the entrance is located within the eighteen meandering courses. Only the patient and persistent may find it's true meaning... The end lies the source you seek.
The found runs deep, the fearless may seek. Darkness it skims, when does it cease? Vileness it purges, Blight it dispels, forever keeping our people protected and well...

findings.name: Memo: An Abstruse Message
findings.text: Water cascades from the heavens above.

findings.name: Memo: An Audacious One
findings.text:
I'm happy.

There were sacrifices and pain, but Wuling City stood despite the disastrous tide.

Our victory was certain.

However, it was an incomplete victory.

Those who attacked Wuling still lurk around the city.

I shall go and exterminate every last one of them.

findings.name: Notes: Physician's Observations
findings.text:
Good. Sore throat and illusions turned out to be caused by hazefyre.

I actually learned something new.

......

We received plenty of injured personnel. The inexperienced staff got a little nervous.

They're just too young.

I was far from nervous. Why? I experienced the North Wuling Exclusion Zone incident ten years ago. I used up all my nervousness when I dug out my fellow seniors from the rubble. We were close to losing the city, but casualties were slight. Days are getting better and Wuling is getting stronger.

findings.name: Antique Enthusiast's Exclamation
findings.text:
They rung all three bells during that huge crisis.

I actually studied the origin of the bells. I thought its knell would be high-pitched and jarring, one that would strike fear in anyone who heard it.

But the tolls of the bell gave a sound that got my blood seething with action.

The bells and drums chorused, together they thundered...

In Yanese stories, the bell is closely associated with the drum.

Perhaps the bells of Wuling woke the indomitable war drumbs within ourselves.

findings.name: Memo: A Lucky Survivor
findings.text:
Truly, I never expected to survive this.

I was in the city when it happened. I was live-syncing Blight Tide data readings to the frontlines via my device...

When I saw those images ... the first thing I felt was despair.

Wuling City looked like a canoe in the great ocean of the Blight Tide.

......

There were times when I placed my hands on my Tianshi apparatus. I planned to off myself if the readings on screen breached the threshold.

......

If the Blight Tide could swallow entire cities whole, what is the Polar North like?

findings.name: Memo: Group Visit for an Injured Friend
findings.text:
Great. I think my punch created a hero.

He probably doesn't want to talk to me now, though some of my words actually got to him.

During the defense of Wuling, I told him that instead of mumbling the Tidalklast's name and staring down a wall, he should swing a weapon, kill a few buggers, and save a few Wullingers...

And so he rushed out with a sword.

He ended up in the medical bay... Thankfully it's just a fracture.

Yeah, so about that group visit, just leave me out. I don't want to agitate the poor dude further.

findings.name: Letter: For the Endministrator
findings.text:
Endministrator:

By the time you read this letter, I will have already left.

Your assistance has improved the Xiranite Nexus, and it no longer poses a threat to Wuling. But an attempt to forcibly seal the rift would not be without consequences.

However, I do know, with certainty, that I can seal the rift on my own. As for the price ... I alone should suffice.

I have penned a letter to grant Ge Yipu and Mi Fu temporary authority over matters of the city... In the end, Wuling will endure and move on, as it has always done.

There was a time when I thought I would never see the departed, that memories would remain as they are — things that linger in our minds.

But you appeared, and the faces of the departed overlapped with the sights. Memories were reignited, one after another, they replayed themselves.

I remember when you first visited the Science Station. I stood in the crowd and gazed at you from afar. I hoped there would be a day when I could share my perspective and ideas with you.

When I finally got my chance, I found myself stuttering and unable to for a coherent sentence... I thought you would probably remember me as a young girl who just kept avoiding you for reasons unknown.

A decade has gone by. You and I are the only ones left from the crowd of yesteryear.

But you still walk amongst us, and you have made me feel that a figment of the beautiful times have remained instead of leaving me completely.

And that is enough...

You are the Endministrator of Endfield Industries, while I am the Viceroy of Wuling.

Wuling is my responsibility, while you are destined to push further into the frontiers and to shoulder burdens of far greater import.

Asking you to join me on this mission is akin to me forcing you to take on my duties, and you have already done so much for Wuling.

So...

Endmin, apologies for reneging on my promise.

As a leader yourslef, I hope you can understand the choice I made.

You've helped me repair the Xiranite Nexus. That is already more than enough. I shouldn't ask for anything beyond that.

After all, it was my negligence that placed Wuling in danger. The suffering of the people and the city is my responsibility...

Furthermore, witnessing a project spanning more than a decade fulfilling its purpose... That is the lifetime wish of any Tianshi.

On this quest for discovery, one's final stop is often the starting point of another.

If this becomes my final stop, then use it as your starting point ... for our push towards the North Wuling Exclusion Zone.

findings.name: Musings: A Go Player
findings.text:
After nearly ten years of playing the game near the water, I finally figured it out.

The Marker Stone is a dead piece.

It could not be replicated or placed throughout Talos-II.

Xiranite mass production is a near-impossible hurdle on its own. Rift suppression machinery and facilities are also extremely difficult to make.

The Marker Stone is the grand technological achievement for Wuling, or the entirety of Hongshan, even. But producing more of it is beyond our reach.

Surveyors and traveling vendors would give us data and intel... And every year, I would read every file at least twenty times. Wuling is the only place in Talos-Il where a comprehensive Xiranite infrastructure is possible...

But a dead piece can be revived again. Hope can be found amidst doom.

We just need a construction system capable of working in wildly different environments.

findings.name: Sentiments: From an Outsider (1)
findings.text:
Every time I look at the Marker Stone, I feel nothing but amazement.

It is the very first nail hammered into the Very Large Rift (VLR).

But we're talking about the VLR... a massive phenomenon with a fissure band measuring dozens of klicks wide...

What price did Wuling pay to achieve this?

I felt compelled to learn more. This is something I should investigate and write about.

findings.name: Sentiments: From an Outsider (2)
findings.text:
I met a master angler.

He told me that the waterways of Wuling, especially the underground rivers, are interwoven and complex.

I started thinking about that. The waterways posed a significant challenge for the Marker Stone's construction.

I guess this warrants some serious investigation.

findings.name: Notes: An Inspector
findings.text:
......

Water quality nominal. The algae are growing well. During every visit, I can't help but spend around two minutes feeling proud of my own genius design.

......

If the Blight manages to infiltrate the water, the algae would be the first to die.

......

A big thank you to my pumpkin-growing friends who managed to revive the horticultural technique.

......

Peace reigns in the Marker Stone today. All is well.

findings.name: Memo: An Inspector
findings.text:
......

Water temperature is okay. Turbidity is okay.

......

Microbial data doesn't look okay. I have to check it again.

......

Lucky me. The problem is caused by my device.

......

I knew the place is super safe. Nothing will happen here.

Everyone knows that the huge basin at the Reservoir Station is meant to buffer against actual floods.

If Blight starts showing up in the water due to a problem at the Reservoir Station or Very Large Rift (VLR), the Reservoir Station must immediately contain the Blight-polluted water, and keep it from flowing towards Wuling City.

However, nothing has happened at the VLR for ten years straight.

I don't think anything is going to happen.

findings.name: Memo: A Sentimental One
findings.text:
I failed to bring my wife and daughter from the North Wuling Exclusion Zone ten years ago. None of my fellow peers made it out either.

There was nothing left in the ruins except for a sapling.

But that tiny thing grew and became massive over the years.

findings.name: Records: Scientist of Horticulture
findings.text:
Yellow Pagoda achieved excellent growth.

Red Fan barely changed compared the data last month.

Green Curtain looks a little sick...

......

Everyone calls me pessimistic, but I believe the truth of life lies within the plants.

Look at them. They continue to grow, even in dimly lit corners like this.

A day might come when the plants defeat the Æther itself.

findings.name: Memo: A Worried Person
findings.text:
The Watchguards just gave us an update. I don't know if anyone noticed the "special haze" or "malfunctions in the Tianshi Pillars".

City physicians and grove rangers would know. They often deal with things associated with the Blight.

Is it not reasonable, then, to deduce that some Æther-related thread is slow making its way towards Wuling.

We need to be more vigilant, especially in the coming days.

findings.name: Incomplete Letter of Recommendation by Tianshi Xi Mo
findings.text:
My disciple is very committed and an eager learner.

This is my disciple. Admission should be considered.

Talented and willing to invest hard work.

A good kid.

findings.name: Rumors: Spread Amongst Tianshi
findings.text:
......

Work-life balance, people. But I just remembered something interesting. I believe there’s a Tunneling Nidwyrm near the discharge outlet.

......

It’s not a wild guess. I was close to that place and felt weak tremors beneath my feet.

......

I wish that were true. Midwyrms are delish. Scale it, debone it, and stew it in a claypot. Just the thought of it! Absolutely divine.

findings.name: Memo: Tianshi on a Feranmut Research Project
findings.text:
Mentor, do you know anything about the Proxy?

I read through the records at the Sui Regulator. She matches none of the Feranmut Sui's proxies.

The power she revealed when building the Feranmut Heart was ... really bewildering.

Maybe she isn't one of the original twelve proxies.

There are so many questions. Perhaps we will only find the answers by studying the traces she left behind.

I shall remain in Wuling for a few more days.

findings.name: Random Writings of a Mountain Hermit (1)
findings.text:
Water cascades from the heavens above?

It pours from the heart, a stream that cannot be severed by a blade.

So composed I am, I can reverse an entire waterfall if I so wish.

findings.name: Random Writings of a Mountain Hermit (2)
findings.text:
All beings focus on life, not battles to the death.

A true grandmaster is one who unleashes the force of nature within an inch, whose blades start as a stream that fills an ocean.

findings.name: Memo: An Angry Angler
findings.text:
I tried to catch this fin for three days and nights.

I chased after it for two days and nights.

I started at the Sword Quenching Marsh and ended up at the Cloudrest Woods. The rivers and streams of Wuling are an interwoven mess.

I can't help but suspect...

...this is no mega-fin, but an Aggelos!

findings.name: Letter: From an Aunt
findings.text:
Dear Babbles:
How are you doing? Clearing up your dinner plate? Did you grow taller?

Your Aunt just moved to Morospolis. It is a busy and very crowded city.

Alright, your Aunt will once again repeat that special line.

Interested in coming to Morospolis and living with your Aunt?

I just don't feel safe leaving you alone in Wuling.

I know there are a lot of nice people over there and Wuling pays for your schooling, but I do prefer taking care of my sweet Babbles myself.

......

Once I'm done with my work here, maybe I'll just move to Wuling.

I really want to give Babbles a proper home.

findings.name: Letter: From Babbles but Never Sent
findings.text:
You're working really hard, my dear Aunt.

Your sweet Babbles is doing well and I am clearing my plate.

Don't worry about me. My home is in the Woods.

I'm a big kid, too. I know how to take care of myself.

I know very well that Pa and Ma had already left and won't be coming back.

That's why I got to stay.

If I left the place, Babbles' Home Sweet Home will be empty, and then it will be gone.

findings.name: Notes: Tour Guiding Script
findings.text:
......

Welcome to the Urban Development Hall, dear visitors...

......

Indeed. This is the very design plans of the Science Station during its early years. As you can see, the Science Station started off as a rather small facility. Now take a look at this crate of documents and files. It is one of the very few items we managed to salvage from the accident ten years ago.

That's right. The courageous Tianshi managed to recover this from the Exclusion Zone, but paid a dear price for it...

......

We can see four Xiranite samples here, respectively taken from these production lots: Experimental Batch 1, Wuling Mass Production Batch 1, Post-Incident Recovery Batch 1, and AIC Factory Batch 1.

These four Xiranite samples represent Wuling's four phases of development.

......

Work is so exhausting...

findings.name: Memo: A Mourning Soul
findings.text:
I'm back, Father.

I left Wuling. I traveled far and long. I visited many places and met many people.

There are other Rifts and Blight... But everyone came up with their own ways to fight back.

They inspired me and re-ignited my hopes for Xiranite and Wuling

You fell during the construction of the Marker Stone. For many years, I could not bring myself to even look at it.

But I have finally found peace within me.

findings.name: Mourning: From a Tianshi
findings.text:
Instructor Zhu, these writings of mine are intended to inform you of good news.

Wuling can finally mass produce Xiranite. We won't need to worry about it ever running out. I believe the threat posed by the Exclusion Zone will be lifted soon. Back in those days, you and the Yinglungs gave your lives to hold back the Blight of the EZ. We now have a working solution to end this for good.

I'm very happy, Instructor. I believe you are happy too.

I've taught your swordmancy to many others, even those outside Wuling. After all, I visited plenty of locations on Talos-II. Whenever people ask me about its origins, I would say an old hero named Zhu came up with it. Then I'd talk about Wuling, the original Science Station, how you worked there and founded Tanjian Hall at the same time, then I'd go on about Xiranite and your sacrifice...

Those who practice your swordmancy would thus learn of the "legacy" it carries.

"Legacy" is a heavy word, Instructor, but I carried it on.

findings.name: Old Research Data
findings.text:
I ran an in-depth analysis of recent Originium Slug fecal samples, and actually found some Xiranite within them.

This means we are very close to success.

Living organisms can serve as intermediate carriers to help with Xiranite dispersion. Our plan of creating a Blight-Free Zone actually has a chance to succeed.

......

Now, the question is, what type of creatures should we use for dispersal?

I believe we should admit quickly that only Originium Slugs, with their extreme resilience, has a chance to achieve success for our project.

As for the burdenbeasts, howlerbeasts, and rakerbeasts we have in the park, I recommend releasing them back to the wilderness.

findings.name: Letter: From a Worried Soul
findings.text:
Research seems successful for now. However, giving Xiranite plant growth models and environmental dispersal mechanisms may be quite a challenge.

......

We still have issues in the algorithmic scripts. After all, plants tend to be phototropic but not Xiranite. If we were to simplify this, we should consider how plant growth models could be integrated with the Originium Arts.

......

We need a "Navigator" with better stability and agility.

findings.name: Old Communication Log
findings.text:
......
The Test Area will no longer be the focus for our next step. We achieved satisfactory results from phase one. The new Tianshi Pillar has been deployed in the wilderness and further reduced the likelihood of the Blight destroying Wuling. This success should be celebrated.

......

They might be moving people out of the Test Area. I have a feeling that the next phase of the research will be focusing on Xiranite production. Well, time to move house to the Institute of Materials Science.

......

Zoological, botanical, and hydrological applications of Xiranite these three fields may be the new focus for the Test Area to work on. Of course, the project on Tianshi Pillar upgrades and optimizations must be kept going as well.

findings.name: Old Project Review Log
findings.text:
APPLICANT'S PROJECT TITLE: Field Test of Tide Flayer Whip Constructed Using Super-Dense Xiranite

PRIMARY INVESTIGATOR: Mo Hen

PROJECT REVIEW RESULTS: Project budget proposal is REJECTED

NOTE: This project requires its investigators to come in contact with Blight-related materials and to be in close proximity with actual Blight Tide. Hazard factors are too high. We recommend the suspension of this project.

findings.name: A project review log that looks rather dated
findings.text:
APPLICANT'S PROJECT TITLE: Testing of High-Density, High- Performance Packaging of Xiranite-Based Materials

PRIMARY INVESTIGATOR: Chun He

PROJECT REVIEW RESULTS: Project budget proposal is APPROVED

NOTE: This project is applying for a sizable quantity of Xiranite. A special review by the Institute of Materials Science is required.

findings.name: Note: From a Stockade Resident (1)
findings.text:
This is one blighted place... And those beasts are mighty fierce...

But we must be here. They murked Big Bro Ruan. We gots to avenge him...

findings.name: Note: From a Stockade Resident (2)
findings.text:
Man who built all this stone stuff? They look super old.

Din't see no awesome loot or weapons. Just plenty of murder beasts...

findings.name: Note: From a Stockade Resident (3)
findings.text:
My Fam say we'll build New Qingbo here. We'll get stronger and conquer the old one.

Yeh, dream on. The entire place shakes like crazy every two or three days. I'd count myself lucky if I survive. Conquer the old stockade? Pfft.

findings.name: Memo: An Yinglung
findings.text:
Such smooth cutting plane... Must have been made by senior Yinglungs who fought the Blightshades.

I can almost imagine how the battle went. The Blightshade emerged from the Miasma and one of us went to meet it. A single cut sliced right through the Blighshade and the machinery behind it.

What a battle it must be!

findings.name: Operation Log: YSTF Team
findings.text:
■/■, All is well.

■/■, Blight Miasma found. No Blightshades. Blight Miasma is then contained.

■/■, 3 Aggeloi encountered and then neutralized. No Blight Miasma found.

■/■, All is well.

■/■, Several pantailbeasts found. The critters probably entered this place to escape the Aggeloi. To establish an Aggelos-free area, clusters outside the Pass have been eliminated. The pantails will be temporarily kept in shelter cages for observation.

■/■, All is well. We have confirmed that the pantailbeasts are not carriers for dangerous materials and can be released any time. Sudden downpour. There may be leakages of dangerous materials in North Wuling EZ. The pantails must not be released for now.

■/■, All is well. The sudden downpour yesterday has no negative influences. The pantails have been verified again and are not carriers for dangerous materials of the North Wuling EZ. The creatures have been released back into the wild.

findings.name: Notes: An Yinglung
findings.text:
The water is good. Very good indeed.

It cascades from the mountaintop, purges the taint from Yinglung Pass, and carries the sediments into the deep gorges...

The deep gorges...

I've been garrisoned at Yinglung Pass for seven years? Or maybe eight. Where did all that water go?

Is there something beneath Yinglung Pass?

findings.name: Yinglung Observation Log
findings.text:
The cloud has cleared. I should check out the place again once I have the time.

I wonder if the old Snowpriestess in the deep snowy forest is doing okay.

findings.name: Notes: Technical Laborer
findings.text:
Cable connection is loose. Just reconnect.

Can't the YSTF manage this simple fix on their own? To think I came all this way just to plug something back in...

Ugh. I thought I could steal a nap today. Welp, I guess I'll only get to sleep at home tonight.

Whatever. Since I'm here already, I might as well look around see if they got other things that need fixing.

......

What is wrong with these people? They're literally doing everything they can to wreck everything they have! THEIR FIXES ARE ALL WRONG!

Welp, at least they're generous. I got some free food.

But their food is a little too strong and oily for my taste. Maybe this is why my baby girl can't gain any weight. She kept complaining how my dishes are tasteless. Indeed. My cooking is really mild compared to the Yinglung fare.

Maybe I should ask them for their secret slimming formula.

findings.name: Notes: Tumu Tianshi
findings.text:
......

Yinglung Pass is now capable of handling the Blight of the North Wuling Exclusion Zone, but there's plenty of room for improvement.

If they keep expanding the place ... the risks would go far beyond what we could bear.

We don't have enough resources and people to expand Yinglung Pass and build Wuling City at the same time...

We've done all that we could... I say we leave the expansions and rebuilding to posterity.

findings.name: Old Entertainment Magazine
findings.text:
......

Knights Major? Or fully encumbered steeplechase? And if everyone is okay with this, we can consider a long-distance event with our Kuranta friends. We'll also relax the rules and rankings.

It's not about the competition, my dear friends. The focus is on getting a nod or even support from the Big Three. We might be able to organize a Band-wide integrated sports event within three to five years. This would prove that our political, economic, and cultural foundations have become strong enough to support such a great endeavor.

......

Our way to the future is fully paved with hope.

......

Of course we do know that people are focused on the recent turn of events in the Polar North. Discussions on sports events and competitions have been postponed.

findings.name: Old Memo: Stained and Dirty
findings.text:
No more retreats. This is where we command our forces and surveillance work. A defensive line must be built.

I know we're still too close, but if we fail to hold this position. the Blight would pour out of the mountain pass and spread.

Our lives for the lives of many more. It's a great deal.

findings.name: Last Words: By Someone
findings.text:
The Blight got me surrounded. I'm gonna die soon.

The chef just took one extra step. Just one! And he just ... melted into the miasma.

But there's something good coming out of this. I witnessed a hellish vision: A giant mass of rolling miasma that consumes all in its path. A form of Blight whose boundaries are ill-defined one that could hardly be seen by the unaided eye. This was all worth it.

I've studied the Blight for so many years. I was obsessed with harnessing it for better use. And now this thing is going to kill me. A death I deserve.

......

I managed to reach this place but I don't see Zhu anywhere That old buddy of mine has some pretty awesome skills. I bet he got out of here safely.

......

I see a few wooden swords... These children would never see adulthood.

......

*Yanese expletive*. You can't beat us forever

findings.name: Old Letter: Undelivered
findings.text:
......

We haven't met for a while, but I'll keep the pleasantries short. You hate reading them, and I hate writing them.

From your last letter, you described Tanjian Hall like it's a kindergarten. You chastised me for ignoring the bigger picture, abandoning a better future, getting myself stuck in Wuling, and accepting my role as a kindergarten principal. I won't even bother shredding your misconceptions.

You learned a few stances of swordmancy from me. You should know better than to assume that teaching children their letters and fighting arts would blunt my edge.

Some of them could barely complete a move at first. Any instructor would be frustrated to see their slices wobble and shake. But as the days went by and wooden swords were replaced by ferrium ones, you'd know the true weight and meaning of "legacy" and "heritage".

If you do not believe me, then come to Wuling.

:::::::::::::::::::::Zhu

findings.name: Weapon Anthology
findings.text:
A six-by-three golden war case of eighteen grids, six of which have been filled.

Most of my seniors and juniors have perished, and most of them even failed to leave a body behind. However, they told me that I could try to salvage the weapons of the fallen and keep them at a place where they could "witness the light of hope".

I pondered for a while and discussed this matter with Instructor Zhu. Tanjian Hall seems to be the most fitting place. They should see the children practice, train, and grow.

The following lists their weapons:

Fire Watcher. Longsword, 2 feet and 7 inches long with a crimson edge and furnished with a white tassel. Fallen at Sword Quenching Marsh. Fully recovered and kept in a grid.

......

Raker Tail. Spear, 10 feet long with a pyramidal tip, decorated with a plume of raker fur. Fallen at the North. Only the spear plume has been recovered.

......

As of now, a total of six weapons of the fallen have been categorized.

findings.name: Memo: For Posterity
findings.text:
All valuable books and publications once offered on this shelf have been safely stashed away. There is no need to search through the rest.

Paper is not a medium made to last. If you read this memo, please make a new copy and replace the old one. For our posperity.

findings.name: Log: Salvaging Op
findings.text:
The crates contain several industrial machine parts.

On first glance, the parts were mistakenly treated as tools for the pre- disaster Science Station expansion project. Closer inspection revealed that they might be parts of a Xiranite-dispersing machine, making them items related to the Xiranite dispersal project.

Remember to take them to the Test Area. See if they belong to any of the Tianshi working on projects related to the Type-C Tianshi Pillars.

And PLEASE use some tact. The sight of the salvage might trigger memories. The last thing I want is one of you spouting blightery like: "Check this out! We found your stuff!"

findings.name: Last Words: A Survivor
findings.text:
I guess I can treat this as ■ supplies ■ should gather and store some ■.

It's already a ■ that I survived.

I think there ■ other survivors ■ nearby, I gotta find out how to ■.

There's some weird thing, though, I think I saw ■ of my vision.

My vision is ■.

findings.name: Memo: A Lost Person
findings.text:
Impossible. What on Talos ■ these people?
