Are they living or dead...? I got this feeling that ■ just shadows.

But ■ might be ... a way out of here.

If I can turn myself into a shadow, maybe I ■ get through that ■ Blight...

Maybe I can use the Originium Arts to transform myself.

Can I create a personal simulacrum with Originium?

findings.name: Memo: A Stubborn Person
findings.text:
I hear the broadcast.

I think they're ■ a search and rescue operation.

But I can't ■ with anyone out there. The Blight is ■ on all sides. ■ be completely ■ up soon.

I gotta think of a way. The Blight Tide research project left some pretty durable Xiranite-based materials here.

But this is not a ■. I must come up with something else.

There should be ■ors nearby. I must meet ■em.

Comms interference is a bummer, but there is always a way.

findings.name: Old List
findings.text:
Xiranite Materials x68.

Cir■ Board x24.

Compressed ■crust x98.

......

Self-Hea■ Ration x60.

Biscuits and Snacks x50.

......

Fortunately, I found several crates of supplies for our night shift colleagues. I still need to find a way out before I starve to death.

findings.name: Scribbled Yinglung Memo
findings.text: Don't get "seen" by it. Switch off all devices. Hand signals only. Infiltration formations.

findings.name: Bloodied Yinglung Memo
findings.text:
The database has nothing on these Blightshades. They're not normal.

Immediate retreat. If you read this memo, regard this mission as failed and aborted.

Leave with the intel.

findings.name: Log of Amber Team: Major Surveillance Op 4
findings.text:
......

"Operational log ten. Recorded by Amber."

"We found contact info left behind by Macro Team... They want us to abort all surveillance missions and return to the 'Boundary' with the coordinates and data."

"We've verified the ID. The logs were made by Macro Team."

"The coordinates... are incredibly close to the Celestial Column. Did someone manage to go beyond the surveillance range?"

"Data within the marked area cannot be verified... I don't know what they saw that made them want to abort the surveillance mission..."

......

"The team has been assembled. We're plotting a path for immediate return."

"What... What's that? Blightshades?!"

"Since when did they start showing up so far out here...? Did the Blight Miasma thicken?"

"Keep moving! You! Head back with the coordinates, now!"

"GO! Go, go, go!"

......

findings.name: Log of Macro Team: Major Surveillance Op 4
findings.text:
......

"Operational log fourteen. Recorded by Macro."

"I've synced the coordinates from Shore with the other teams. Including that specia set... Someone's aborting the surveillance mission. Current objective is to ensure we send these coordinate data back."

"The Blight Miasma concentration at the Quelltide Levee is far higher than we expected...I don't know how long our wrist cuffs can last."

......

"We take the shortest path back to the 'Boundary'. Someone must bring these coordinates back.. The other two teams will take the conventional route."

"As for Shore ... her team will try to move further in... We've given them most of our Yinglung Pillars."

"May fortune smile on both our teams."

"We still got a long way back.."

findings.name: Letter: For the Family
findings.text:
......

I know you're worried, but ... duty calls. This is the largest exclusion zone surveillance operation to date. We have four teams working with us. Don't worry. They spent a really long time planning out every detail, and I don't think it's confidential anymore.

Speaking of which, I haven't been home for three years. Is my baby Amber doing okay? Once this operation ends, I'm going to apply for a few days of leave.

I can't help but feel guilty about my absence. especially when the times got really hard. I've thought it out already. Once this operation ends, I'll resign from this post...

Youths nowadays grow up fast. Remember Arcane and Summit? They're good enough to hold their own. Nobody could resign because there were so few of us But now, we're seeing the light at the end of the tunnel. Plus, my old wound kinda hates it when I stay at the frontlines.

Remember that previous letter where I said how beautiful Wuling City looks? The Viceroy might be young, but she has everything covered. I'm thinking about getting a house over there so that Amber and you can move in and we can live as a family. It's close enough to Yinglung Pass so I'll get to visit the lads every now and then.

Be patient and wait just a while longer. We'll meet each other soon enough.

findings.name: Data Log: Yinglung Pillar Coordinates
findings.text:
......

Tanjian Hall: Planting complete. Coordinates below:

[ATTACHMENT DAMAGED]

Quelltide Levee: Planting complete. Coordinates below:

[ATTACHMENT DAMAGED]

Tianshi Pillar R&D Center: Planting complete. Coordinates below:

[ATTACHMENT 3]

findings.name: Communication Log
findings.text:
......

[Audio data damaged; generating text transcript]

Do you know what that means, Stern? It means that we've been wrong for all these years. What happened eight years ago wasn't even an accident...

Our mission is to create a safe passage to Tanjian Hall, Shore.

We have only one chance at this! Someone must safely deliver the coordinates! Someone must know what we have found!

The Miasma is getting thicker. We might be the last ones to ever reach those coordinates!

(Sighing)

We have to do this, Stern. If we don't, nobody after us would find a way to this place.

Give me your team's Yinglung Pillars. All of them.

Stern...

Let the other three teams take care of pillar delivery. We got a rough road ahead. You won't make it there on your own.

We'll pave the way. Let's go.

Go and leave the spark.

findings.name: Audio Log: Damaged
findings.text:
......

PID verification complete

Personal codename verified: Benefit

[Audio data damaged; generating text transcript]

Blightshades... I hate fighting things that look just like our comrades.

I'm pretty much done ... and it's almost time...

But the War Cases of my fellow Yinglungs can't just be left here. And Shore ordered me to deliver those coordinates...

If you find this case, bring it back... The exclusion zone is not a place for us...

I got one Yinglung Pillar left... Hur... Let me see how far I can go.

...Sorry, Task Leader Shore... I've let you down...

......

findings.name: Letter: Looks Like a Will
findings.text:
......

That sword...

Miasma concentrations kept changing, but we never experienced tremors like those.

And that was how I discovered the sword... An actual sword! That accident eight years ago ... the Very Large Rift ... it was no accident. The sword caused it...

I found it by chance, but I can't just head back like this... The Miasma thickens with every moment. We'll never reach this far after this...

Macro, Amber, and Benefit have started to turn back. They'll definitely deliver the coordinates, but...

Someone must remember where the sword is... The land itself is collapsing and sinking... Topological references would be useless. Someone has to stay behind...

I ran a post-landslide simulation and predicted where the sword might end up at. The coordinates are provided in the attachment.

This is my final report ... and my personal will...

A friend from the TGCC once asked me why we Wulingers yearned to return to the exclusion zone when we had only lived at that place for a few years. He questioned why we Yinglungs kept throwing away our lives in vain, like crazed fowlbeasts pouncing into the flames...

He's wrong... The path paved with Yinglung sacrifices is not just a way home... It's the VLR... that's where our duty lies.

If people completely abandon the region of Wuling, the VLR will make every Talosian pay a bloody toll... It is our duty. No Wulingers can afford to back down. Not a soul of Hongshan can afford to ignore it...

I pray there will come a day when another expedition could trace the path by marking where we fell ... follow the Yinglung Pillars planted by Stern... and purge this cursed Miasma for good...

It'll let us know that we have finally fulfilled our vigil...

findings.name: Records: Written by Someone
findings.text:
Pinewoods, snow, and a mountain.

Just like Samivegr.

Just like the Sami as described in the records.

I found the right place.

findings.name: Memo: Messily Written by Andre
findings.text:
Am I trapped?

......

Can't find a way out.

......

If I fall asleep, will I never wake up again?

......

Puccini, I know you're on the other side of the river. Stop waving to me!

......

POPOV! WHY THE HELL ARE YOU HERE AS WELL?

findings.name: Strange Yanese Tales of the Supernatural
findings.text:
(Messy handwriting) Very invigorating!

......

There is a Yanese tale of unclean beings created by "distractions". Such beings are neither demon nor phantoms, and lack a permanent form.

When night falls, these unclean beings would secretly feed on the sentient subconsciousness and memories of their hosts. And thus, without any signs of poisoning or ailment, the hosts would die as their minds fade away.

......

(Messy scribbles that convey fear) WHAT THE HELL! I should stick to coffee to stay awake next time.

findings.name: Memo: Neatly Written
findings.text:
I should go. I must leave.

Put this place behind me, and free myself from unrealistic fantasies.

findings.name: Memo: Old and Worn
findings.text:
I have submitted a report regarding the Snowpriestess to my superiors.

As for those who found themselves lost in this area, there is no need to panic or worry. Find your way to the cabin. Help and shelter can be found there.

::::::::::::Yinglung

findings.name: Page: Torn from a Notebook
findings.text:
......

To Him, the fall is only temporary.

I shall continue to press forward under His gaze.

......

findings.name: Memo: An Inspector
findings.text:
A rather miraculous reaction... I wonder if I could carry it back and grow it...

It might work with Endfield's Automated Industry Complex...

findings.name: Notes: A Hopeless Soul
findings.text:
The food is gradually losing its taste.

I might be losing my appetite. Maybe it's my ideas. Perhaps it's my desire?

There is no sound, no response...

Everything is losing its meaning.

findings.name: Memo: Member of the YSTF
findings.text:
I haven't been here for a while. The place has changed a lot.

The bridge did not collapse from an attack. The presence of other hazards or threats in this area can be ruled out.

The Snowpriestess's creations are likely to have gone "feral" after her departure. They could no longer perform their reparation duties.

The findings have been compiled and reported to my superiors. There is no need for concerns.

The creations will continue to pose a threat. Approach with caution.

findings.name: Memo: Left Under the Branch
findings.text:
I did not expect such a young little sapling to respond to my calls.

It is another sign of fate. The forest itself is helping me.

Perhaps they can help me chase away fowlbeasts that accidentally enter my Array.

No. It won't work. The fowls will just build nests on them.

findings.name: Letter: Drafted by a Snowpriestess
findings.text:
I had a nightmare. A crimson Talos hanged over my head while I trudged through the woods.

I kept walking to leave its presence, but only exhausted every ounce of my strength.

At the moment of my collapse, the suffocating nightmare was dispelled by a sudden gust of cold wind. The freezing sensation woke me.

I raised my head and realized I was only a few steps away from the edge of a precipitous drop.

And for some reason, the forest became wholly covered in snow. Distant mountains, donned in pristine white caps, gradually revealed themselves through the fog.

That sudden coldness ... can it be a revelation from Sami?

I didn't get anything for years, not in any of all those dream dives I'd made. This is the first time I've grazed past His tracks.

Here I shall stay.

findings.name: Notes: A Snowpriestess's Dream
findings.text:
Night, with Low Heavenly Lights

I heard the sound of hooves but the fur was too thick. I was jolted from my dreams and couldn't get back to sleep afterwards.

Night, with Full Moon and Shrilling Fowls

It was a short dream where I saw small, flickering lights of fire.

The Hunting Moon

I haven't dreamed for a while. Autumn hardly came to the valley, and the winter felt colder than the last. This place is becoming more like Samivegr.

Afternoon, with Migrating Hornbeasts

While heading to the east of the valley, a blurry idea came to me. I can use the stones here to build a sturdy fireplace.

Night, with Howling Winds

In my dreams see the flickering fire and the outlines of a forest cabin. I figured out what He is trying to say.

findings.name: Research Notes: By an Old Snowpriestess
findings.text:
Valley south. The Breath of Hoarfrost has injured a lactating hornbeast ewe.

Is there a way to keep them out of the ritual area?

Oh Sami, please give me a sign.

Breath of Hoarfrost-improvements: Impossible

I had the woodcrafts move the berry shrubs out of the valley. It worked.

findings.name: Notes: Records of Various Findings
findings.text:
The hornbeasts from the south don't taste as good. Meat is too lean for roast. Good enough for stew, though.

The merchant who fell off the cliff gave me excellent herbal spices perfect for marinating long-ear fillets.I still feel very warm after the meal.

......

The long-leafed herbs growing at the bottom of the valley are good for hornbeast stew. When sending the next fowl post north, make the beast take some of the herbs along.

findings.name: Andre's Research Notes
findings.text:
...Installing this upgrade kit greatly improves the integration and efficiency of the PAC and all facilities under its control.

This allows the deployment of additional production lines and the capacity for supporting higher tier manufacturing and supply logistics. Conflicts during operational allocations and resource wastage will also be reduced..

findings.name: Handwritten Notes: Translated by Typhoeus
findings.text:
Ritual: Scroll of Spirit Calling

If the spirit is trapped in the depths of the dream, find an open place surrounded by ancient trees and raise shrines accordingly.

The three shrines are connected to one another, thereby creating a channel that breaches the barrier between dreamscape and reality. The opening lets the seeker peer into dreams, and lets the lost see a way out.

During the ritual, no living being is allowed to cross the ring...

findings.name: Notes: Final Words
findings.text:
This is the seventeenth attempt. And the last one.

I followed the records and created the shrines in the forest. Countless times I've cut my fingers and moistened the snow with my blood just to hear Him breathe.

I thought His eyes are still searching for a way home behind the gossamer veil.

But there is nothing. I can't sense anything...

I am so old that my sight is failing ... I want to leave. The shrines, the runes, and the rituals... I no longer have the strength to sustain them.

If anyone were to discover my notes, please do not scoff at my weakness. At least I could steal a last glance of Myrkwood and Wintertooth Mountains ... before I went.

findings.name: Diary: Last Entry
findings.text:
It failed again....

The channel was reopened. Numerous witchcraft spawns entered but nothing was found.

I knew my body wouldn't survive this winter. Blood came up when I coughed and it soaked the earth beneath my feet.

But I will not leave.

I shall die here. If you find me, turn my bones into arrows and my spirit into lamp fire... Purge the obstacles ... and light the way...

If anyone were to ... pick up this diary, I beg you to complete what I've started.

Help Him find a way home.

findings.name: More Handwritten Notes: Translated by Typhoeus
findings.text:
Ritual: Scroll of Spirit Diving

The three shrines have been established, but only offer a glimpse of the dreamscape's reflection.

Another three shrines must be set up. The dream diver's brows can be used as the inducing agent to unite the powers of all three shrines. This will allow the seeker to dive straight to the depths of dreamscape.

Opening the channel is one thing, but the path of return will be hard to seek...

findings.name: Notes: Scrawled
findings.text: Success. Even the mountain rocks are helping me.

findings.name: Quick Tour: Urban Landscape
findings.text:
Welcome to ■. Call me Lin. I'm a simple records keeper of the Records Hall and l'm pleased to be your tour guide for this Open Day event.

Allow me to introduce the various sights and venues of Suiming City.

The first thing you see upon entering the city is the memorial stele set to commemorate the founding of ■. Keep an eye for the list of names provided at the base of the stele. They are the first cohort of workers who took part in the earliest days of the construction. This city only exists thanks to their selfless contributions.

As we continue down the path after the city entrance, we can see the massive Waking Bell. It is the landmark of ■. Tianshi Feng, one of the city's urban designers, applied for its construction. Originally intended as an early warning system against the Blight, the Waking Bell is now a unique sight of the city and a perfect place for taking memorable photos.

From the Central Plaza where the Waking Bell is located, we can either head to the Tianshi Pillar Project Records Hall, the Tianshi Pillar Applications & Material Engineering Research Labs (TPA-MERL), or the Youth Physical Training Field.

The Tianshi Pillar Project Records Hall is where I usually work. The facility not only houses plenty of Tianshi Pillar research data and Blight observation logs, but it is also a trove of information on the various ecosystems around ■. Everyone is more than welcome to request photocopies to satisfy their curiosities.

As for the TPA-MERL, its opening hours are extremely short and subject to regular rescheduling. I recommend visiting the place only after we recommend a suitable date and time.

Finally, the Youth Physical Training Field is where many young Tianshi disciples spend their time. The recent fad of athletic training seems to be a form of kicking exercises involving Globular Originium Slugs... Perhaps some of you might be interested in slug-kicking.

However, we must remind you that the Training Field is rather close to the extremely hazardous Underground Blight Monitoring Zone. You are advised to stay close to your tour guide. Do not attempt to explore these areas on your own...

findings.name: Signs of the Disaster
findings.text:
Records ID: HS-ER082409

ARCHIVED BY: ■ Post-Disaster Assessment Team

Having compiled various findings and records, we can safely categorize Event ER082409 as a super-large-scale Blight event caused by a periodic fluctuation of anomalous intensity in the Blight Tide.

4 hours prior to the Event, the Underground Blight Monitoring Zone has logged an extremely rare and anomalous Depth reading. However, interference by the Blight Tide caused failures in communication facilities and prevented the reading from being uploaded on time. The Waking Bell, which served as the final node of the city's early warning system, also failed to sound the alarm due to internal failures. As a result, many individuals in the city still did not evacuate within minutes of the Event.

A number of researchers identified inexperience and lack of countermeasures on the part of Hongshan Academy of Sciences (HAS), as opposed to the force majeure nature of Event incidence, as key and primary causes that led to the worsening of the disaster as it progressed. Emergency Tianshi Pillar deployment and Blight suppression could not be enacted on a timely manner. These actions missed the golden window of opportunity, allowed the Event to escalate, and culminated in the tragic disaster.

findings.name: Manual for Emergency Response to Blight Tide Disasters (Excerpt)
findings.text:
Basic Countermeasures - Must Read for ALL Residents

I. Pre-Disaster Warning

Always refer to official announcements and monitor the status of the Waking Bell. The Bell will be struck 3 (three) times for emergencies. Upon hearing 3 bell strikes, EVACUATE the city immediately WITHOUT DELAY.

II. Rules for Evacuation

Evacuate through the main city entrance at an even pace and follow evacuation signs and road markings. Do your best to evacuate together with your family and avoid separation. DO NOT return to the city to pick up your belongings.

III. Post-Disaster Details

If you accidentally come in contact with Blighted bodies of water or Blighted fluids, get emergency treatment and head to the designated Depth Reading Test (DRT) location for testing. All articles of clothing shall be sealed away in a refuse pack and discarded. DO NOT attempt to wash or reuse contaminated clothing.

(A line of fine print is provided below)

No disaster is a laughing matter. Always keep these countermeasures in mind.

findings.name: Miscellaneous Morsels of Suiming: Snacks (Excerpt)
findings.text:
The Pillar Cake is a specialty snack of ■.. It was invented by Tianshi Lu, who was extremely committed to Tianshi Pillar research and spent many sleepless nights to work on the project. One day he felt famished, but the kitchen staff had already left. Desperate, he took some dough left on the counter, kneaded it into the shape of a pillar, and steamed it quickly. When he opened the steamer, the dough resembled a pillar with an expanded roof, not unlike that of an actual Tianshi Pillar. It was firm outside, spongy inside, delicious, and filling.

His fellow lab mates followed his steps, but also applied multiple layers of dough and mashed jujubes in between to symbolize the pillar's mysterious inner workings. Cutting the improved pillar through the middle also revealed a beautiful multi-layered cross-section like an actual Tianshi Pillar. The cake thus became a traditional festive food of Suiming. Many citizens would knead and steam Pillar Cakes as gifts, for they convey the auspicious message of "Sturdy Pillars and Comforted Minds".

findings.name: Letter: Tucked Between the Pages
findings.text:
Ma:

Hope this letter finds you well. How are you doing? I heard you coughing during the last call. Try to get something warmer because weather's getting colder.

I'm doing pretty well here. Work at the Records Hall isn't too hard. Remember that Conference I mentioned? The results are out and ... they didn't choose my proposal. Welp. It's alright, I guess. Some higher-ups met me in private to talk about this. My approach was sound and I'll still have my chance. No need to worry about me, Ma. I'll keep working on it.

Oh yeah, did you try the cake I sent you? It's a local snack with quite an interesting taste. If you like it, I'll send two more boxes back home. Our neighbors might like it.

One more thing. You kept telling me to settle down. Guess what? I think I found someone, so it's one less thing to worry about... Yeah. I'll tell you more once I head back next time.

And please do look after yourself. Try to visit your old BFFs, you know. It's unhealthy to stay indoors by yourself.

Your little boy is doing alright in this pretty big world. I just kinda miss those braised meat noodles you make, though.

Loving Son, Ji Lansheng

findings.name: Notes: Probably Written by a Disciple

Like I said...

That blighted Big Chen is a cowardly cheat. I asked him to check if Old Man Lu is planning something. And he chose NOT TO SHOW UP the very next day!

findings.name: Page: Torn from a Diary
findings.text:
My woman started asking about my retirement.

Told her it'd be soon. Once they retire this batch of outdated Tianshi Pillars, I can finally rest my creaky old bones.

Old lady believed none of it. Said I told her the same thing two years ago.

I knew she's kinda right. I'm not educated like the Research Labs scientists or Records Hall staff. I wouldn't know when the Pillars would retire. So I just told her I'll be quitting next year, Probably.

Truth be told I actually had a chance to retire. But people gotta have dreams, you know. An ordinary man like me just want to see the Blight cleaned up for good.

A lot of people, my woman included, would end up in deep Blight if someone makes a silly mistake. I can't enjoy my resignation if I allow those raw inexperienced recruits to take over my job.

So whatever. I'll just keep slogging and see if I'm good for another year.

I'll look for a chance and talk to my supervisor about this.

I thought about my next post. They can literally assign me anywhere ... that's not too cold. I don't want to end up in a place where I gotta keep myself warm throughout the year.

findings.name: Memo: A Finder
findings.text:
So many years had already passed ever since I steeled my resolve, quit myjob, and left Luoyi. I wanted to find the many secret views of Talos-II. Forty years I've spent on this endeavor.

......

I was young and talented, but now I'm just an old lady with many chronic pains and ailments.

I returned to Wuling but failed to find the realm within the painting. Fate has not decreed our reunion.

My life is almost at its end. It's time to head home.

findings.name: Etymology of the "Cleansing Pool"
findings.text:
Though I was only born recently, I am confident in my knowledge regarding the secret history of this painted realm. My skills are on-par with those of my senior peers.

Many of my peers and friends link the phrase "Cleansing" to our Lady's special inkstone washing basin. But this is erroneous. The term fails to match the couplet: "Long have I pursued, the arts of brush. Thus create I, the Inkstone Wash."

So what is meant by the word "Cleansing"?

After numerous visits and lengthy conversations with my senior peers, I have arrived at a well-founded guess.

The "Cleansing" was for the waregeist seniors who were first made by our Lady.

We must understand that these early waregeists were very unruly. They rampaged throughout the realm, ignored geistly hygiene, and caused plenty of mischief that really annoyed our Lady.

Now I am sure about this answer because the Cleansing Pool is exactly that. A gigantic bathing pool for the waregeists.

findings.name: Recipe: A Test, Very Messily Written
findings.text:
Modern recipes are not creative at all.

......

Names and ingredients are boring and bland... But do they have to be?

.....

To achieve great fame, one must seek a quicker path.

.....

Caudal Goldscale and Blightshade Bezoar. How does this sound?

.....

It's still lacking philosophical aesthetics. Diners won't be able to fully appreciate the dish because of this issue.

.....

I'll get my pal to try it out. If he plops over and dies, our Lady would just resurrect him.

findings.name: Memo: Ingredients
findings.text:
Ingredients are the easy part. We can keep them simple. The kitchen staff has the skills to please the diners.

Seasonings are running low. We need more salt, sugar, and cooking kohl.

This place was originally meant to cook some late night snacks for our Lady. The most complicated thing we did was just some random dessert. Setting it up as a proper establishment was a shocking decision for all of us.

.....

And why did you get so many pumpkins? Are pumpkins cheap in Wuling?

findings.name: Guesses by "Job Rusher"
findings.text:
Our Lady couldn't eat a bite for the past two days. From what I see, it's definitely Seš'qa's fault.

Everyone (or a few people) knows that our Lady loves buying very, very weird things.

She probably failed to get her hands on a limited-edition Witchcraft toy from Seš'qa. The last one she got was an ugly (just my very humble and personal opinion) doll that talks. She had fun with that for a while.

.....

Maybe they started selling other weird stuff again.
Or maybe they organized a really exciting concert, but our Lady failed to secure a ticket.

.....

Like me. I couldn't get my hands on Liino's show. AAARGGGH!

findings.name: Guesses by "Speed Dasher"
findings.text:
Just two days ago I brought our Lady a tray of cakes but she did not feel hungry.

I knew at once what happened.

She's becoming like the chubby lung!

I knew it.

I heard about the recent stupid slim-tail fashion fad of La Fantoma. Every kid was making selfies with their tails and comparing them to canned drinks or milk tea cups.

No! I wasn't comparing our Lady to a kid!

But she visits La Fantoma all the time. Anyone would be naturally curious about their latest trends.

findings.name: Guesses by "Loud Speaker"
findings.text:
I heard our Lady hasn't been excited about food for the last couple of days. She also looked pretty sad.

I heard the latest New Wrankwood movie was a mellow drama focused on family, love, and responsibilities.

Perhaps our Lady misses her own family from time to time.

.....

If I had to guess, I think she's more worried about missing the first wave of popular reviews by the time she arrives at New Wrankwood.

findings.name: Memo: Seriously Written by a Sketcher After Extreme Joy
findings.text:
That little girl who gave me a fright!

SHE'S...

BY TALOS!

Look at this painted world! I wish I could just stay here forever and never get chased out!

Why did even waste time making studies on the Eight Scenes of Wuling? They're nothing compared to this!

The rivers! The clouds! THE BURDO-MUCK!

It's pure technique and emotions! Everything in this painted world is priceless! A single glance can net me a fine arts degree! Two glances will make me the Saint of Fine Art!

findings.name: Memo: An Ink Spirit
findings.text:
This menu is boring as hell!

IMAGINATION!

I'm not seeing it at all. Every menu item bores me!

Tm gonna tell our Lady about this nonsense!

findings.name: Memo: About Spirit Money
findings.text:
First, I owe you an apology.

I actually stole a bit of Spirit Money yesterday, then sneaked to the kitchen to make a dish with it.

(I cleaned the wok, people! l really did!)

......

But it didn't taste that good.

The Spirit Money we've been recently getting ... were probably paid by Wuling disciples, or Tianshi who have to slog on their projects everyday...

They taste quite bitter.

findings.name: Memo: An Unintentional Trespasser
findings.text:
This village ... looks a little strange...

It looks as if everything is following some sort of a cycle.

It's really weird.

findings.name: Memo: A Diner
findings.text:
This place actually feels like home. And that's really odd.

I'm not the only one. The others who sneaked into this place with me also felt the same. But we came from different towns and lived different lives...

It seems as though the place is a manifestation of "home and nostalgia".

It's so magical.

findings.name: Muses: One Who Studies
findings.text:
......

Someone painted the machines that supply Xiranite, but the Xiranite itself ... is real.

I had many ideas before entering the painting. One of them even regarded it as a whimsical realm composed using specialized chiaroscuro effects.

But now, as I scratch out these words on paper, my previous ideas have already been overturned.

The "virtual elements" of the painting, if it could be combined with the "realistic elements" of our labs, might help us defeat many existing technical challenges.

findings.name: A Very Minimalist Ink Spirit
findings.text: According to legends, an Ink Spirit who yearned of the outside world hid itself in a stack of signed photo giveaways so that someone would take it out of the painted realm... Wait. That ink splotch on your photo just moved a little.

findings.name: Memo: Moon Gazer
findings.text:
I once heard how the sun, the stars, and the moon have their own courses and orbits.

Just as mortals enter the living world in the endless cycle of night and day, so too do they depart in the same endless cycle.

If that is the case, where was I born? And where will I die?

Will it be in the lotus pond outside the window?

......

Finally did I arrive at my epiphany. Since the lucky stroke of transforming inspiration that gave me sentience,I have not "changed" for quite a while.

Maybe I should try doing something else.

If anyone were to see a white lotus blossoming in the pond in the future, that will be me.

findings.name: Gentle Miscellany
findings.text:
(This Miscellany is a Record of a Nongye Tianshi's Achievements. The Power of Si's painting probably made it feel rough and grainy. You brush your hand against it, and feel the labor of sowing and harvesting.)

"Tianshi Cereal". Cereal is not her last name, but an abbrevetion of her honorary title: "Tianshi of the Five Cereal Grains". This title is only awarded by the HAS to the most outstanding of Nongye Tianshi, and Tianshi Cereal achieved it by successfully breeding the first generation of crops completely acclimatized to Talos-II. However, Tianshi Cereal refused to turn up to the commendation ceremony. HAS quickly notified her and made her attendance necessary. Instead, she sent a new gourd variant with a label that read: "Dumbokin". One of the senior Tianshi in the panel of judges was so angered by this act that he split the gourd in half during the ceremony and declared that he would prepare a "feast" with it and stuff every piece of the "roasted dumbokin" into Tianshi Cereal's mouth.

Many crop variants bred by Tianshi Cereal were widely grown throughout the Civiliazation Band. Ironically, nobody knew the location of Tianshi Cereal's testing farms. Every piece of information regarding her whereabouts was also closely guarded by HAS.

A testing area reported how their farmers once saw a round, chubby house. When they approached it, they picked up the delivious smell of vegetables and fruits. Closer inspection revealed that the entire house was carved out of a massive gourd. The farmers were shocked and quickly reported this to the local watchguards.

When they returned to the house, it was already very much munched through by a herd of hungry burdenbeasts.

Many people wanted to get to the bottom of this strange event. However, none of the news agencies decided to follow up.

The testing area, however, reaped a bumper harvest that year.

I am just a farm worker. The only thing I could do is just to sow more seeds and harvest more crops.

But I know that a great burden is laid upon my shoulders.

There are still people starving in the Band. They'd do anything to get a bite.

If my research puts one more meal on the table of fills the stomach of a family, maybe evil will cease?

Indeed. I believe this, from the bottom of my soul.

In the foreseeable future, I shall continue to tackle the great problem that even Terra failed to solve.

May the seeds of kindness be fruitful.

-Excerpt from an interview with Tianshi Cereal

......

findings.name: Easygoing Miscellany
findings.text:
(This Miscellany is a Record of a Chef's achievements. The Power of Si's painting probably made it smell like delicious food. You cannot help but feel hungry.)

THREE spices are essential for cooking. THREE cookbooks are essential for your kitchen.

And these are: "Bistro Recipes"; "Make Some Chow"; and "Everyday Family Meals".

"Bistro Recipes" is a must-read for anyone who intends to make a living from food services and catering.

"Make Some Chow" is more practical and covers a huge range of ingredients. The recipes are not gourmand-grade, but will really make you full.

"Everyday Family Meals" is a work for someone cooking for a family of three or four. It's the one book to keep them happy and eating.

All three cookbooks were written by the same author. He left no name, but simply called himself the "Lil' Chef".

But everyone who read the cookbooks knew a true master at once. No one in his trade was ever his equal.

After the first centennial of the Talosian Calendar, people started addressing him as "Lil' Chef Maestro".

Despite our immense hatred for the Aggeloi, nobody ever tried to eat them to sate their fires of fury.

Aggeloi do come in all sizes, shapes and forms. It's just that none of them looked edible.

So what was on that Lil' Chef's mind when he decided to slice up one of them, and then swore that he would find a way to make them delicious?

Just look at what the Aggeloi are made out of! Grit! Mud! Water!

They might be poisonous! Or they might contain stuff that transforms us into Aggeloi! And that's even worse!

BY TALOS! He's tasting it! Look at his friggin's face! What's that weird expression?! Can it actually be edible?!

No! Don't give me that! It looks like pute! I'm not eating it!

Oh okay. Fine ... I'll take a bite...

Hmm...

GIMME MOAR!

We're now looking at the most famour destination of this region! The legendary - Fine Broth Spring.

It is said when they invited Lil' Chef Mestro to asses the research of the local Nongye Tianshi, he decided to catch a free-range fowl to make a feast for everyone.

Unfortunately, that poor fowl happened to be the subject of a local disciple's thesis. Semesters of hard work ended up as a bowl of delicious food.

To compensate the poor kid, Llil' Chef Maestro took what was left of the fowl and started a joint project with the Tianshi disciple. The beautiful Spring we now see is the result of their efforts.

A draw of Fine Broth Spring tastes like plain old water at first. But when used in cooking, it heightens the savoriness of the ingredients. Everyone's welcome to ladle a serving and try it out in the kitchen afterwards.

Oh? What happened to that unfortunate disciple?

You probably missed the first part of the story. That disciple grew up and became our, uh, late Director. He passed away a few years ago. We laid him to rest in the back hills.

Yes. Exactly. Director Nong.

Wait, hold on. I never mentioned our Director's name. How did you -?

Hey. Where did he go?

findings.name: Strong Miscellany
findings.text:
(This Miscellany is a record of a Warrior's achievements. The power of Si's painting probably kept it shaking with a unique rhythm, despite the reader's struggle to hold on to it tightly.)

In the earlier records, the "Pugilist of Hongshan" was portrayed in almost comedic fashion. He was someone with incredible combat skills who sought to challenge every warrior of Talos-II and seize the title of "Supreme Master of the Fighting Arts".

And because he is from Hongshan, he naturally targeted every military organization under the HAS. Various watchguard districts, the Yinglung Special Task Force, and the Bureau of Swordmancers found him a source of nuisance.

Nevertheless, he was peerless in combat. No one in HAS was his match. The HAS then stepped in and granted him the title "Pugilist of Hongshan". With that, he finally shifted his gaze away from the region and started picking his fights elsewhere.

Various folk tales also described how the Pugilist of Hongshan challenged every school of martial arts in the tradtion of "door busting". The solution was supposedly: "Leave no doors but keep the door frame. Taunt no one and give no cause for grief."

Many martial artists of Hongshan began looking up to the combat techniques of the Pugilist. However, he was also an avid traveler and gave neither formal instructions nor authored any manual.

There were also rumors of the "Pugilist" offering teachings of wisdom, but most turned out to be scams that cheated people out of their money. In spite of this, his reputation alone continued to attract a huge crowd of self-proclaimed adherents and disciples.

Someone once visited the Pugilist's home and found only a dusty tome titled "Martial Codex" on the table. Everyone knows that the "Martial Codex" is a clssical work of Great Yan, but it only contains instructions for basic exercises, strenght building and athletic training routines, and leading a healthy life. It was definitely not some "powerful technique" that people were clamoring for. But the visitor flipped it open and found handwritten comments of astonishing value.

"Seek flowing water and stillness in movement. Wait for the flow to freeze and let all settle into serenity. Exit the ice by shattering the shackles, then wait for the annual cycle once more."

The training routines described were simply too challenging. Not many people dared to attempt it.

The sky poured and thundered. Thirteen days and thirteen nights of storm tainted by the Blight laid waste to Hongshan.

The Puglisit of Hongshan returned to a horrendous hellscape. Many of his compatriots lay dead.

People saw a lone figure scaling a great mountain, cursing and roaring at the heavens.

Lightning illuminated the skies and the face of the Pugilist of Hongshan.

A Sundering bolt struck down at the Pugilist with a deafening blast. He answered with his fist.

The Empyrean arc broke and the rain scattered. Having endured the strike, the Pugilist let loose a mighty roar and threw another fist at the heavens.

The storm clouds broke open, and thus ended the calamity.

Since then, when people spoke of his title, they did so with a voice of respect and reverence.

findings.name: Tipsy Miscellany
findings.text:
(This Miscellany is a record of a Wandering Poet's achievements. The power of Si's painting probably made it give off the smell of a wondrous brew of kohl. It feels as though there is a strange spell capable of bringing the reader's mind to another world.)

I remember the times when I was a kid. A very well-dressed lady often visited our family establishment for a drink.

Alway she came in already tipsy. Always she ordered more drinks. Always she washed them down, mumbled a few words slammed the coins on the table, and staggered her way out.

My grandfather told me she was educated, and a loyal patron. Many years passed and many things became different. But the lady remained the same, and her routine hardly changed.

Perhaps my grandfather already knew her back in Great Yan. It'd be amazing if that were true.

Since that realization, I always sat at her table whenever she came to sate her thirst. With a plate of peanuts I coaxed her for stories.

Though there were occasions when the kohl knocked her senseless, she usually had something interesting to tell me. She said things like "the views of Great Yan" and "border citadels in the wastelands". She also told me this: "You got Tianshi potential, kid. I can see you commanding armies one day."

Me? A Tianshi? And commanding armies? Hahahaha.

If I'm Tianshi material, then why couldn't anyone in my family read?

A Tumu Tianshi of HAS always has to contend with crushing deadlines, challenging tasks, and stringent budgets. Every job was as stressful as laying down a straight production line within a slug shell. Kohl was a refuge and without knowing it, I became addicted to the spirits as well.

I heard Endfield came up with something awesome that could ease our workload, but I don't know when they're going to deploy that in a decent scale.

I left the factory for more kohl at an inn, and somehow ran into a familiar face.

My Grandfather had left me for more than a decade, but the lady had not changed at all, looking just like how I remembered her when I was a kid.

The innkeeper told me that she was a loyal patron and generous one too.

Hold on.

That means our place wasn't her only watering hole.

But my family shop was on the east side of Hongshan. This inn was on the west side...

I felt a pressing need to satisfy my curiosity, so I treated her to some drinks and coaxed her for answers.

"Coincidence, I guess," she said as she washed down the kohl I poured for her.

If you're reading this letter, I'm most likely dead. Killed by the Landbreakers.

As a member of HAS, I got to lead my people and fought to the last. I die a satisfied man.

I don't have much to my name, and hardly have any regrets either.

Just kinda felt sorry for my parents. I also miss a drink with that strange lady.

(THe lower half of the sheet is soaked through by kohl. Someone else has written a comment.)

An ambition fulfilled, a dream concluded.

There was once an HAS Tianshi who mastered the forge and the Originium Arts of fire. She left a great number of works that range from infrastructure in various Band cities and Tianshi Pillar Arrays to street-side ornamental sculpturers and artificer-grade weapons.

However, it was extremely difficult for anyone to commission a private work from her. The reason was surprisingly singular. Once she ignited her forge, only the creativity erupting within her mind would be faithfully reflected in the work. No one, save for the senior HAS Tianshi, could persuade her to simmer down her unique and blazing hot inspirations.

Yet this was exactly why her works were often featured in TGCC auctions. The directors of New Wrankwood paid great fortunes just to feature her incredibly intricate yet awfully purposeless works in their movies.

Have you heard the wondrous tales of Tianshi Cinnabar and Tianshi Cyan?

People say they are a pair of Tianshi with incredible talent. Though sisters of the same family, their personalities could not be further apart. They bickered in every moment of their lives and even swung their fists, blades, and arts at each other just to prove they were right.

If you were to meet the two Tianshi at an intersection, they would "invite" you to arbitrate on the path they should take.

Of course, your decision would never convince both of them. One of the sisters is guaranteed to keep you company as you continue your path.

"What's so strange about traveling with a Tianshi?" you might ask.

I am about to tell you that.

I have walked this trail a few times. But whenever I shared the journey with Tianshi Cinnabar, the road would become far wider and all the waregeists would be neatly arranged. It felt like a walk through an Empyrean vault.

Tianshi Cinnabar also proved to be an interesting companion. Her disposition was friendly, sunny, and amiable. There was hardly a moment of boredom when traveling with her.

Alas, upon reaching the next intersection, things would get back to normal.

And when Tianshi Cinnabar sees Tianshi Cyan again, my advice is to seek a place to hide.

Why do that?

I did mention how the siblings are always trying to prove the other wrong.

findings.name: Detached Miscellany
findings.text:
(This Miscellany is a record of a Fine Artit's achievements. The power of Si's painting probably made its landscape ink artworks a hiding place of its contents. Those who cannot discern deeper meanings would lose themselves over the shapes and contours.)

The Tianshi generally refers to special casters from the Hongshan Academy of Sciences (HAS) who can perfectly blend Originium Arts into their field of expertise or sector of industry. Examples include Tumu Tianshi (civil engineering), Nongye Tianshi (agriculture), and Mentor Tianshi.

And since the landscape ink paintings of Great Yan is an integral component of Hongshan culture, we have reason to believe that Danqing Tianshi is an actual role of HAS.

What is "Danqing"? It refers to the ppigments of cinnabar and cyan, an elegant euphemism of ink painting. Being called an Artist Tianshi is not at all exciting or respectful.

The paintings featured in our gallery, like this one, are works of an unnamed Danqing Tianshi.

The work hardly used any ink and the composition is extremely clever. Most importantly, "flocks of fowls" would fly in and out of the painting everyday. This wondrous Art raked me quite a sizable profit from ticket sales alone. It might even fetch me enough cash to buy a nomadic city plate if I were to sell it at an auction.

Oh, look. It's time. Witness how the "flocks of fowls" return to the painting...

Wait. Why are they perching on your shoulder?

Oh, b-by TALOS! I'm a fool! Master Artist ... Tianshi!

Yes, yes! I did it! I acquired ... I-I mean, I seized it from a poor old man from Hongshan! I was enthralled! I needed to have it! So I hired some muscle to take it from him...

Wh-WHA?! What do you mean? I can be the painting's best friend since I like it so much?

NO! PLEASE! I BEG YOU! I got wife and kids! DON'T TURN ME INTO AN ART FRAME!

NUUUUUHHHH -!!

Details on Tier-One works of Qihu Painting Competition

Recently, this Committee has received many letters asking about the winning works of the COmpetition. This Committee thus decided to publish this article on "Qihu Morning News" to inform our curious inquirers and to get in touch with the fine artist who produced the said works.

The competition was a timed on-site painting event. Works were then submitted to the panel of judges when the time ended. Halfway through the event, however, a Tianshi suddenly barged into the vanue, surveyed the event, drew a beauteous landscape on a white wall with a brush-shaped wand, and then left with the same elegance as her arrival.

The white wall turned into a breathtaking vantage of the mountains framed by a dried riverway. The ink was the water that poured into the scene, the master stroke that breathed life into the already fabulous work. This Committee therefore decided to award the 1st Place Reward to the fine artist. However, we must admit to the fact that she could not be located despite our best efforts.

This Committee then ranked the other works and held the award ceremony. A great rain began to fall right after we rewarded the 2nd Place artist. We thus ended the event early to protect the contestants' work.

When the Committee returned to the event venue on the following day, we were initially disheartened to see that the rain had completely washed away the painting on the wall. This quickly gave way to astonishmenet when we discovered a gentle brook behind the wall and saw the ink painting turned into an actual landscape. We quickly photographed this wondrous phenomenon, receiving intense and positive public response when we posted the pictures online.

That is the general gist of things. Relevant information has been made available to the public.

It remains our sincere hope to get in touch with the 1st place artist so that we may have the chance to converse with this most talented creator.

Merciless, cruel, and vicious raiders known as the Landbreakers roam in the frontierlands miles away from civilization.

Every nomad and frontiersmate grew up with these words: "You best listen or we'll give you to the LBs!"

Little Chuck from the Jones family was no exception.

.........

As usual, Little Chuck went to the bazaar with his burdenbeast and spent a good part of the day haggling just to trade a month's worth of foraged herbs for a small bag of wheat. The sun was sinking down the horizon when he prepared to head home. Little Chuck chose an unfamiliar shortcut to make it back in time but heard strange howling and shouts halfway down the road. He quickly led his burdenbeast behind a large rock and hid there.

.........

They turned out to be Landbreakers!

Little Chuck was terrified. Silently he studied these gaudily dressed Landbreakers from behind his rock. The raiders gathered around another piece of rock and started painting it with a colorless and transparent substance.

Little Chuck thought they would keep doing this till night time when the Landbreakers suddenly stopped. They took out their shovels and dug a huge pit before the rock.

They buried all sorts of treasures and loot that Little Chuck had never seen before.

"Is this how they hide their loot?" Little Chuck thought to himself.

.........

To be continued...

findings.name: Aburrey the Hero
findings.text:
Aburrey was an educator who heroically sacrificed herself protecting students during the Aggeloi assault on Valley IV in Talosian Calendar, Year 75.

In Talosian Calendar, Year 75, numerous Ankhor points descended upon the outskirts of Valley IV stretching defensive forces thin. A small Aggeloi contingent breached the perimeter near a school facility. Aburrey successfully evacuated her students, but the entities pursued relentlessly. As the retreat reached the under-construction pass near what is now the quarry entrance, Aburrey scaled the heights to gain tactical advantage. Utilizing explosives from the construction site, she triggered a calculated rockslide that halted the Aggeloi advance. Her actions safeguarded both the quarry and her students, though she perished in the detonation that secured their escape.

In her honor, the UWST designated the nearly completed quarry as "Aburrey Quarry". Operations were later suspended when excavations uncovered a mysterious substance. The metallic structure, far exceeding humanity's current technological understanding, was subsequently named the "Stone of Aburrey".

findings.name: Ætherside
findings.text:
The Ætherside is an overarching term for describing areas where Depth reading is at 1 in subterranean, surface, atmospheric, and orbital regions of Talos-II. Given the time scale of Talos-II, the Ætherside is currently overlapping with realspace. Flow of matter and energy between the two dimensions has been verified as a feasible possibility.

In Talos-II, the barrier between the realspace and Ætherside may sometimes rupture to create an inter-spatial conduit (and in rare occasions, disrupt the very time scale itself) colloquially referred to as the "rift". Depth readings near rifts typically approach 0.5, which also means that Active Blight has a higher probability of occurring at these places.

Cultivating Originium or deploying activated Originium can effectively reduce depth readings in surrounding areas, thereby helping contain breaches in Æthersides to some extent. However, this effect lacks consistent patterns. At times, Originium activity may instead be suppressed by rifts. In regions with active Ætherside phenomena, facility and machinery reliant on Originium Arts often experience significant operational interference.

The consequences of matter transitioning from reality into Æthersides are random and unpredictable. What remains certain is that all biological processes essential to sustaining life experience severe disruption and obstruction within these domains. Conversely, when matter emerges from Æthersides back into realspace, it generates Active Blight in realspace. Consequently, matter exchange experiments between realspace and Æthersides face strict restrictions under the Band Accord, with the vast majority of related live-subject testing explicitly prohibited.

Unlike physical matter, energy flows unidirectionally from Æthersides into realspace through potential energy conversion. This phenomenon occurs even in the absence of rifts, making related studies a primary focus in the field of Ætherside utilization. However, when this energy flow exceeds certain thresholds, it frequently triggers random and uncontrollable explosions.

Humanity's comprehension of Æthersides remains profoundly limited, particularly since distinguishing them from known subspace. The prevailing hypothesis suggests Æthersides constitute a separate universe, one quietly undergoing heat death while saturated with lethal toxins. Subspace, in this framework, would serve as the membrane separating Æthersides from realspace. Yet such theories currently lack substantiation through mathematical models or experimental observation.

findings.name: Æther Test Site
findings.text:
The Æther Test Site constitutes a specialized testing facility erected by the UWST within the Power Plateau.

The UWST established this facility specifically because the Power Plateau contains a "naturally stable rift", a rift showing no observable expansion over extended periods, with minimal Blight risk. During Valley IV's initial planning phase, scientists proposed developing the entire Power Plateau into an integrated Æthertech Research Center combining exploration, study, and application. This recommendation remained unaddressed for years. After nearly two decades of colonial development, the UWST finally certified the valley's environmental safety. They subsequently lifted the northern region's lockdown and constructed the Æther Test Site atop this strategically vital location.

Since Talosian Calendar, Year 90, the UWST has conducted a series of experiments at the Æther Test Site, including dimensional stability maintenance and internal Æther observation trials.

findings.name: Aggelos
findings.text:
The Aggelos (plural: Aggeloi) refers to any hostile and animated entity comprising natural matter and a halo structure, and is created by an Ankhor via catalytic construction. Throughout the history of humanity's expansion across Talos-II, the Aggeloi have always been our primary threat. The Aggeloi War was named after the enemy fought by humanity.

There are 4 currently verified modes of Aggeloid behavior: (1) construction; (2) deconstruction; (3) mimicry; and (4) attacking humans / human-built objects. However, since the Ankhor-induced Aggeloi formation process resembles that of industrial production, we are uncertain if the Aggeloi can be classified as a living or biological lifeform.

The construct pattern of an Aggeloid entity refers to its outward appearance, mode of movement, and means of attack. A single Ankhor tends to create Aggeloi with only a limited number of construct patterns, though they may include occasional non- or alter-pattern variants. Hence, an Ankhor's property is defined by the range of Aggeloid construct patterns it can create.

Since the First Aggeloi War, humanity has encountered new construct patterns of Aggeloi, giving rise to the Standard Aggeloid Classification (SAC) system. SAC is designed to help users search and identify weaknesses and best tactics for neutralizing a particular Aggelos.

Currently, most Aggeloid threats come in the form of raids stemming from unknown sources or random Ankhorfalls. Nevertheless, humanity's history records described how the entirety of the Northern Frontier was destroyed within 24 hours after the First Aggeloi War broke out.

The Aggelos is likely to remain as the greatest challenge faced by human civilization on Talos-II.

findings.name: Apparitions
findings.text:
Entities known as Apparitions have been created using the powers of the Feranmut named "Sui". It is a general term to describe supernatural entities capable of autonomous activities and actions.

Apparitions are not biological organisms by nature. They are created when the power of "Sui" is, whether deliberately or unintentionally, applied to physical objects. There are also many forms of Apparitions. Examples include Ink Spirits created by ink painting, and Waregeists, which are mundane objects and utensils imbued with the powers of "Sui".

Tales and stories involving Apparitions are common in regions under Hongshan Academy of Sciences (HAS) jurisdiction. Most of these tales came from people who accidentally ventured into Si's Painting. They include seemingly normal people or creatures that, upon closer inspection, reveal traces of ink they left behind; and extremely drunk kohl gourds or weapons that "kept rushing around". Sightings outside Si's painting have also been reported, like tea shrubs tainted with ink or passers-by who suddenly disappear while they were asking for directions. Such hearsay has become an interesting topic for everyday conversations with friends and neighbors. Of course, Si herself probably treats this idle chatter, often exaggerated in varying extents, as noisy complaints that disturb her peace.

findings.name: Ancestral Spring
findings.text:
The residents of Qingbo Stockade named a natural source of water within the Stockade their Ancestral Spring. Rumors claim that the Ancestral Spring is capable of purifying the Blight and dispelling external threats.

Folklore of the Stockaders claims that the Ancestral Spring was first discovered by the founders of Qingbo Stockade when they sought refuge at this location. The ability of the Ancestral Spring to purify the Blight became the key feature upon which the Stockaders built their community. For years, the Stockaders held ceremonies and festivals at the Ancestral Spring. They also furnished it with water-collecting waterwheels and bamboo water chimes as tokens of remembrance for the deceased. All sorts of myths and legends revolve around the Ancestral Spring, gradually transforming the source of water into the foundation of the Stockaders' faith.

Unknown to most, the purifying powers of the Ancestral Spring were not a miracle. They were actually achieved by the presence of a Yanese irrigation machine located at the bottom of the Ancestral Spring. This machine was installed over a century ago by Yanese Tianshi, and it kept the water clean by separating the Blight from the flowing aquifer. Given its age and lack of maintenance, the Blight buildup within the machine was close to reaching critical levels and posed a risk to Qingbo Stockade located at the ground level above. In the end, a knowledgeable Stockade resident sincerely asked the Endministrator to seal the machine with Originium Arts, thus ending the extended and exhausting operational run of the machine.

Though the Ancestral Spring has lost its "special powers" from the past, many Stockade residents believe that the spring is still protected by the gods. The irrigation machine that rests quietly at the spring will eventually be swallowed by time, though it may be the last witness to a particular period in history.

findings.name: Aurora of Talos-II
findings.text:
During the very first hour after the First Aggeloi War broke out, Endfield Industries received numerous witness reports of strange "cascading veils of light" appearing in northern Talos-II. The full extent of the strange lights was only documented after the successful launch of OMV Dijiang into its artificial orbit. People will call this veil of light the Aurora of Talos-II for over a hundred years afterwards.

According to mainstream belief, the Aurora of Talos-II comprises 2 parts. The first being the lower portion of the Aurora that exhibits structural and energy profiles similar to those of the Terran Starpod, essentially making this lower portion the Auroral Barrier (though this assumption remains controversial). Fortunately, the Auroral Barrier only surrounds the north polar region and several isolated pockets of Talos-II and does not envelope the entire world like it did on Terra. The second part is the Æther Tide that stretches from the ceiling and origin of the Auroral Barrier to its outer envelope. This Tide would appear as the static Aurora visible to the unaided eye. Æther bursts and flares occur on a regular basis within the Aurora as it spreads from the north pole of Talos-II, leaving powerful Active Blight phenomena in wake.

For the last century or so, multiple attempts to approach the polar north with auto-drones have failed. No orbital deployment systems have succeeded in breaching the Auroral Barrier, and no low altitude aerial vehicles are capable of surviving the intense Auroral Blight. Hosts of Aggeloi active in the Auroral Region are extremely protective of areas surrounded by the veils of light. It is essentially impossible to traverse these areas by land.

The Terran aurora is a natural phenomenon only visible in northern Ursus and Sami. However, Talosians have realized that the Aurora of Talos-II is a ticking clock for humanity's existence on this moon.

findings.name: Automated Industry Complex (AIC)
findings.text:
The Automated Industry Complex (AIC) is one of the key technologies of Endfield Industries, and represents the successful miniaturization and modularization of industrial production machinery. A small team of professionals armed with the AIC technology can quickly deploy a fully functional automated production line.

The earliest design principles of the AIC were already proposed even before the frontiersmates of Talos-II departed from Terra. The traditional approach involved moving entire city plates to relocate production lines. In contrast, portable and modular processing facilities that can be deployed according to specific needs were regarded as the next stage in the advancement of Originium industries and production.

This proposal was deemed extremely suitable for the environments of Talos-II. To convert theory into reality, Endfield committed vast amounts of R&D resources. Years of repeated testing, redesigns, and reiterations carried out at the joint Endfield-UWST Hub Base finally arrived at a build capable of satisfying most production requirements. Currently, AIC field deployment authority has been granted to the Endministrator.

findings.name: Beast Lord
findings.text:
Beast Lords are unique entities. Neither esotericists studying mystical and occult knowledge nor scientists with empirical data based on Originium Theory have succeeded in providing an accurate definition of the Beast Lords. We understand that even though Beast Lords assume the form of (or bear a close resemblance to) various beasts before humans. Thev are in fact closer to vessels bearing data on animal "likenesses".

Of the many questions on the origins and nature of Beast Lords, only one has a definite answer: The Beast Lords are directly created by the effects of Originium. As the influence of Originium spread across Terra, the Beast Lords began to appear in various chapters of Terran history. And as Terran Civilization prospered and grew, many Beast Lords chose to coexist with humans in their own ways. Some remained invisible or only occasionally manifested themselves as close companions of various rulers, guardian spirits watching over ancestral homelands, exceptionally talented musicians, or ultra-rich magnates whose wealth rivals entire nations.

We have reasons to believe that Beast Lords are still very much alive and close to us.

findings.name: Blight
findings.text:
The Blight is a general term for describing hazardous subterranean, surface, atmospheric, and orbital phenomena of Talos-II. Such phenomena can be divided into two categories: (1) Active Blight and (2) Static Blight, of which Static Blight is often regarded as the residual remains left when an Active Blight episode has subsided.

Classical cases of Active Blight, such as Blightfloods commonly seen on the surface or Blight Tides in bodies of water, tend to exhibit optical properties unique to the Blight often seen as fluorescent displays of strange colors. The phenomenon of Active Blight can inflict dissociative and/or inversive destruction of variable rates to any object it contacts or swallows. In other words, Active Blight can deprive matter and/or time from the physical space it manifests in. This destruction can either be rapid and absolute or slow and slight. After a period of time (the shortest duration on record is 217 ms while the longest is over 149 years), Active Blight will slowly decay into Static Blight that resembles a layer of fluid asphalt covering the remains of the destruction wrought by Active Blight.

The Blight exerts unique effects on sentient lifeforms. Survivors of Blight events often report auditory and/or visual hallucinations, sudden episodes of stress, or other mental conditions even in the complete absence of Blight-induced brain injury (BLIBI). NOTE: Almost all cases of BLIBI fail to survive.

Having gathered more than a century's worth of samples and data, we can now confirm Active Blight appears in places where Depth readings hit a positive number. Probability distribution of Active Blight incidence is typically a bell-shaped curve against an x-axis of Depth readings from 0 to 1.

findings.name: Blightshades
findings.text:
According to the field of Æther sciences in the Civilization Band, "Blightshades" are considered extremely rare phenomena of Æther activity.

Blightshades represent a form of "Æther-replicated entity" capable of autonomous actions and high levels of aggression. According to existing witness reports, Blightshade entities are extremely rare, appearing only where Æther activities are most active or in the worst Blight-stricken areas.

Blightshade entities would replicate the form of a biological organism under the direct influence of Æther activities and when completely consumed by Blight matter. In the absence of external stimuli, most Blightshade entities would mimic basic behavioral patterns of their source organisms while alive. When disturbed, Blightshade entities would exhibit advanced motor functions and cognition, and assume a behavioral pattern that seeks to violently remove or destroy the source of disturbance. Researchers have received isolated reports of Blightshade entities attempting to communicate, though no solid evidence has been secured so far.

The mainstream hypothesis for the existence of Blightshades and their behavioral principles proposes that: Blightshades, in essence, are sites of weak Æther activities fixed in the material universe, and are manifestations of residual data of dead lifeforms that cannot be completely removed. However, even though Blight-handling personnel of various Band factions have accumulated substantial experience in dealing with Blightshades, the existence and behavioral principles of such entities remain an inexplicable mystery.
