findings.name: Reconveners
findings.text:
ACCESS AUTHORITY LEVEL: 8

OPTICAL ID: Not required for Authority Level 8 access

BUG/WIRE SCAN: Passed

FILE CATEGORY: 302

The Endfield HR database has a list of special operators whose profiles are managed separately and locked behind an incredibly high Authority Level. These special operators have the right to directly communicate with senior corporate officers of Endfield Industries, and all of them are special Rhodes Island liaisons working at Endfield pursuant to the Framework Agreement on Special Technical Roles and Co-Operation Between Endfield Industries and Rhodes Island Pharmaceuticals. Most of these operators usually do not work at Endfield facilities and do not carry out Endfield assignments on a regular basis. Instead, they are often involved in various roles throughout Talos-II.

These special operators are also known by an esoteric title: Reconveners.

The First Originium crystal that traversed the Cosmic Gate to arrive at Talos-II was contaminated in the final battle of the First Aggeloi War. The very fundamental nature of the info-crystal was damaged, causing degradation in its properties. Despite the contamination, several intact data shards remained within the chaos of its Assimilated Universe. Should anyone wish to navigate the corrupted data streams within, these shards can be perceived as a never-extinguishing beacon of blinding light.

To achieve various objectives, both the Endministrator and M3 tacitly allowed Warfarin (the leader of Rhodes Island at that time), to conduct emergency repairs and decontamination of the First Originium. For reasons unknown, the reversing nature of Æther was greatly slowed near the data vein. When Warfarin deciphered this data vein, Depth readings of a data shard underwent a spontaneous spike as it decrypted from the Assimilated Universe into realspace.

The first Reconvener also arrived at Talos-II by accident and without the Endministrator's knowledge. Warfarin was also unprepared for the arrival. Every Reconvener who left the Originium Woods has been friendly and willing to work with Rhodes Island and the Endministrator. All of them also seem capable of realizing that they are a unique individual, despite sharing partial knowledge of the life experiences and interpersonal relationships stemming with "distant" memories of Terra. Such knowledge also allows Reconveners to use skills and abilities wielded by their original counterparts.

Warfarin later found a way to commune with the data shards. Despite the concerns of others aware of their existence, she began to actively explore the Originium Woods. Warfarin encountered data shards willing to set foot on Talos-II, and thus she designed a process to better lead them out of the Woods and enter the new world. Many Reconveners arrived at Talos-II while the Endministrator hibernated. The Reconveners began exploring the world and seeking their own destinies, and they did so with the goal of assisting the Endministrator in mind.

Leading Reconveners out of the Woods is essentially an act of creation. Warfarin bore the responsibilities for her actions though she would occasionally vent out her frustrations to Endfielders who knew of this project. After every stress-fueled episode, she would remind everyone how years* of extensive experience taught her that everything was worth its while. *NOTE: The years of extensive experience Warfarin claims to have are subject to change, with the figure being 500 years a century ago, 300 years half a century ago, and dropping to 20 years in her most recent claims.

Any Rhodes Islander and Endfielder is willing to trust in the beacon of the Woods as well as the wills that followed the light and emerged from the roiling chaos.

I believe so too.

findings.name: Samivegr
findings.text:
Samivegr, a Sami term that literally translates to "The Way to Sami", is the primary habitat of various Sami tribes in Talos-II. The Samifjod (Sami people) also registered their community in the Band Accord under this name. Located near the Order of Steel Oath forts, the cold and frigid Samivegr is also the northernmost settlement of sizable scale on Talos-II.

The Samifjod's journey from Terra to Talos-II was rather unique. They did not follow any of the Science Expedition convoys. Instead, they rode on a Feranmut's back to cross the space-time boundary. This particular Feranmut, also named "Sami" (and sometimes referred to as the "All-Father"), is one of the largest Feranmut specimens known to humanity. The Civilization Band knows little about its past experiences in Terra. From the oral traditions of the Samifjod, after accepting revelations of "hunt", "rest", and "choose" and divinations from sixteen major assemblies, the Samifjod decided to follow the Feranmut to "new lands" and devote themselves to the "new mission granted by the All-Father".

The Feranmut Sami later fell in war. Its carcass then changed the local environment and transformed it into the "Samivegr" region we know today.

Most of the Samifjod in Samivegr adhere to their ancient way of life and traditions. They are divided into many tribes scattered across the land, each led by a leading caster known as the "Snowpriests". The Assembly of Snowpriests serves as the representative of the various tribes and partakes in various affairs of the Civilization Band. Given their long martial traditions that survive till this day, the tribes are famous for raising many excellent fighters. To date, Samivegr tribal volunteers remain the most important and stable source of recruits for the Order of Steel Oath.

A typical Samifjod would say that they have nothing in Talos-II except enemies and methods for making war against them, and they do not need anything to change this fact. The name "Samivegr" is their collective interpretation and manifestation of their spirit: The All-Father has died for us, but His way has remained, and His will is eternal.
findings.unlock: Progress through the side mission A Dreamscape Shattered by Her Arrow

findings.name: Seš'qa
findings.text:
Seš'qa means "The Stop" in the language of the Sarkaz. The Sarkaz built Seš'qa as their home on Talos-II, and it also serves as the organization representing their interests in this world.

Ever since the outbreak of the First Aggeloi War, the Sarkaz of Kazdel have fought in nearly every major conflict in Talos-II. The Snowpriest of Sami thus gifted the Sarkaz a fang from the fallen Feranmut, perhaps as a token of gratitude, or to uphold a new prophecy revealed by the Foldartals. With their witchcraft, the Sarkaz converted the Feranmut fang into a floating anchor, much like the "Lifebone" of the past. Around this anchor, they built a floating city named Seš'qa — far smaller than the free cities of TGCC and the steel citadels of UWST. "The Stop" proved a fitting name for this Sarkazian community.

After the war ended, many of the Sarkaz walked away from their traditional isolationism and chose to become part of the Civilization Band. Seš'qa did not oppose the trend. Instead, they became brand managers, opinion leaders, and mediators and eagerly offered their services for the Civilization Band. Though the floating city has retained its functions as a massive military airship, it is also a window. The city contains a theme park, a theater, and a bazaar open to the entire Civilization Band. It is also the headquarters of the famous brand — Witching Hour. Skilled witch-crafters and mercenaries remain the most famous trades of Seš'qa, but these no longer define the stereotypes of the Sarkazian people.

War is no longer the constant companion of the Sarkaz. They have finally tilled the soil for a new life.

findings.name: Si's Painting
findings.text:
Si's Painting is the name of a special pocket dimension created using Feranmut Power, one that cannot be explained with conventional science. Since its entrance is physically close to the Very Large Rift. the path into Si's Painting is usually closed to keep out residents of Wuling who might enter the realm by accident.

Si's Painting is a blend of both physical and fantastic elements. The realm itself is extremely realistic vet surreal at the same time. From the records of Hongshan Academy of Sciences (HAS) and Si's personal descriptions, the realm is actually a scroll of painting. Members of Si's family gave it to her as a present and to serve as her residence. After settling in the painting, Si used her powers to alter the realm to her liking, painting areas such as Hear Not Lake, Ask Not Peak, and Xiaohe Manor. Of these places, Si spends most of her time in an inn named Yuanyuan Manor. She painted every single element, ranging from its layout to its internal decor and ornamental plants. It is said that the Endministrator once lived in the Manor for a few days and left quite a few memories there.

Many strange tales and stories were created during the time when Si's Painting was not vet completely isolated from the outside world. Many Wulingers who accidentally stumbled into the Painting and witnessed its beauteous landscapes described it as an otherworldly sanctuary. Others who encountered Apparitions who played tricks on them treated it as an alien world of vicious ghosts and phantoms. Of course, Si herself probably treats these wishful tales or stubborn claims as noisy complaints that disturb her peace.

findings.name: Stragglers Grove & Grovenymphs
findings.text:
The Stragglers Grove form a distinctive ecological landscape surrounding Wuling City.

Outwardly, the Stragglers Grove appear as a monobotanical ecosystem, an unremarkable bamboo forest. This illusion initially deceived ecological Tianshi from Wuling Science Station, until monitoring devices placed deep within the woods repeatedly appeared outside the grove. After thorough investigation, the Tianshi reached a definitive conclusion: it wasn't the devices moving, but the grove itself.

The Tianshi discovered that beneath the grove's soil, a native Talos-II insect species had formed a symbiotic relationship with the bamboo. These insects replaced the plants' tangled rhizome systems, sharing water and nutrients with the bamboo growing on their backs. When stimulated by external factors, they burrow through the ground to relocate. During massive Blight Tide seasons, they collectively migrate to higher ground. Hongshan Academy of Sciences' ecological Tianshi named this species the "Wuling Grove Rhizome-Weaver", commonly called "Grovenymphs".

The Stragglers Grove and their grovenymphs provide living specimens for Talos-II's flora and fauna research. To this day, the Tianshi of HAS maintain deep fascination with this remarkable symbiosis and its startling parallels to Terran ecosystems.

findings.name: Sword Vault Dale
findings.text:
The Sword Vault Dale is a valley located southeast of Qingbo Stockade in the region of Wuling. Rumors say that the place is home to a secret vault containing technological relics from the First Aggeloi War.

This area is often the subject of short fiction and novelettes in Wuling. The popular series titled "Twin Heroes of Yan" chose Sword Vault Dale as the site where the hero buried the sword and retreated into seclusion. Other short stories often depict the vault as a mystic sanctuary filled with numerous weapon blueprints and long-lost technologies. However, the actual conditions of both the Sword Vault Dale and the secret vault were known to only a few. The site also became buried under the Blight following the outbreak of the First Aggeloi War, and almost all writings that mentioned the place were lost in the chaos that followed. Historical records mention how "the Ministry of Rites and Ministry of Works jointly constructed a secret vault at this site", and this was used as a reference by historians from the Hongshan Academy of Sciences to speculate that the dale-bottom vault may contain copies of intricate technologies or heavy machinery that could help explore and develop Talos-II.

The retreat of the Blight Tide has revealed the Sword Vault Dale to our sights once more. Extensive site investigations conducted by a team of explorers revealed that the vault contents were largely precious collections of literature and fine arts produced by the various nations of Terra. Actual data found in the vault named the nation of Yan as the founder of the project and builder of the vault that houses the embers of humanity. Their aim was to create a cultural ark on Talos-II for the imprints of civilization that deserved to be remembered, and to ensure that posterity would not forget the "Road of the Past" taken by their ancestors.
findings.unlock: Complete the Urgent Side Mission: Deep Vaulted Steel

findings.name: Talos-II
findings.text:
Talos-II is a natural satellite of the gas giant named Talos.

The frontiersmates from Terra re-opened the Cosmic Gate and first stepped foot upon this moon 152 years ago. Talos-II has a nitrogen-rich atmosphere, enough oxygen for life, and sufficient greenhouse gases to keep it warm. However, the alien sun and the massive gas giant that looms in the skies are constant reminders for the pioneers and the countless light-years that exist between their current location and their distant homes.

Fortunately, the great mountain ranges, crisscrossing river systems, and rich vegetation cover nurtured a rather resilient biosphere. After the Cosmic Gate collapsed, the Terrans survived on Talos-II for well over a century. Natural resources have been essential to supporting the livelihood of local populations. For generations, the stranded Terrans and their descendants built and expanded various outposts and towns across this world and created new footholds for civilization.

According to astronomical observations, there are an undisclosed number of natural satellites besides Talos-II orbiting around the gas giant, but only the latter is habitable. Given the unique position of Talos-II in this star system as well as the presence of the Cosmic Gate, we have reasons to believe that this habitable environment was not a coincidental gift of the Universe.

findings.name: Talos-II General Chamber of Commerce (TGCC)
findings.text:
The Talos-II General Chamber of Commerce (TGCC) is the most influential corporate conglomerate of Talos-II. TGCC members cover every sector of manufacturing and services, ranging from leading arms manufacturers from the Age of Terra to food catering franchises with stores along the frontier.

During the First Aggeloi War, the TGCC was in charge of maintaining the Talos-Terra lifeline. Now that the war has ended, truck convoys stranded in the alien world continued to roar across the roads, making commercial economies, messenger-based courier services, and modern lifestyles possible in Talos-II. With hands tightly gripped around the steering wheel, the truckers cruised across the lands with headlights blazing, carrying containers filled with supplies and resources to link the growing camps, villages, and towns upon the new world. Though the industrial giants of Old Terra remain a dominant force, the truckers who earned the trust and respect of the Talosians during the war became masters of their own destiny. And thus they transformed into the Conductors steering the great wheel of the TGCC.

To date, the upper echelons of the TGCC prefer to call themselves the shadow investors and proprietors of the Civilization Band. They love the quarterly financial reports and annual meetings with their shareholders as well as the splendorous beauty of the great cosmopolis. TGCC leaders believe the Practice they have codified is sufficient in defining the present and future of Talos-II. Such confidence was essential for helping humanity endure their darkest hour, but people often forget how addictive it could be.

findings.name: Terra
findings.text:
Terra is a distant planet, the home of the present civilization on Talos-II — yet the relationship between these two worlds is profoundly complex.

In the distant past, the ancestors of Terran Civilization originally inhabited Talos-II, later venturing to Terra where they built a glorious civilization amidst Catastrophes. One hundred and fifty-two years ago, they crossed through the Cosmic Gate once more, returning from Terra to Talos-II. While most celebrated this as "Paving the Way", those few who knew the historical truth would whisper another term for it — "The Homecoming".

Several years later, the Cosmic Gate was destroyed during the First Aggeloi War, severing all connection between Talos-II and Terra. The surviving humanity could only reminisce about their ancestral home through fragmented records.

With an average radius approximately 1.55 times that of Talos-II, Terra bears planetary dimensions far exceeding its colonial counterpart. Yet remarkably, the cyclical rhythms of day and night, along with seasonal variations, demonstrate negligible differences between the two worlds. This synchronization is widely believed to be the result of precursor technology, an unknown mechanism that somehow calibrated both planets' rotations to match some lost celestial template. It is this mysterious harmony that allowed the people of Talos-II to seamlessly adopt the fundamental calendar systems brought from Terra.

Terra stands as the primordial birthplace of Originium, where the "Prime Veins" first emerged and vast crystalline clusters dominate the landscape. Its resource abundance dwarfs anything found on present-day Talos-II.

From the moment humanity first crossed the Cosmic Gate, scholars have tirelessly attempted to determine the celestial relationship between Terra and Talos-II through comparative astrometrics, searching the skies of Talos-II for any trace of their lost homeworld. Yet to this day, such research has made no conclusive evidence to pinpoint Terra's location among the stars.

findings.name: The First Aggeloi War
findings.text:
The First Aggeloi War refers to the decade-long conflict spanning from Talosian Calendar, Year 5 to 15, fought between humanity and hostile forces primarily composed of Aggeloi. Historical records predating Talosian Calendar, Year 142 document this conflict simply as "the Aggeloi War", referencing the same engagement. The war divides into two distinct phases, separated by the pivotal events of Talosian Calendar, Year 11.

The war's initial phase was marked by catastrophic disasters caused by the Aggeloi and widespread chaos among human forces. Within the first twenty-four hours of the conflict, suddenly emerging Ankhor points allowed massive Aggeloi swarms to overwhelm and obliterate humanity's earliest cities around the northern Cosmic Gate, Talos-II's inaugural city. They seized complete control of the polar region, potentially triggering the phenomenon now known as the "Aurora of Talos-II" through means that remain unknown. The subsequent six years saw surviving human populations driven southward under relentless Aggeloi pressure, progressively losing technological capabilities throughout their forced migration.

By Talosian Calendar, Year 11, the current Endministrator had assisted the remaining human factions in reorganizing their forces, enabling effective resistance against the Aggeloi incursions. This marked the transition to the war's latter phase. Following a major military campaign in Talos Year 15, Aggeloi activities in southern regions were finally contained. Significant events during this period include Sami the Feranmut joining the Aggeloi War, the "Wild Hunt Uprising" initiated by Sami's followers, and founding of the Order of Steel Oath.

For humanity, major Aggeloi disasters and combat operations concluded by the end of Talosian Calendar, Year 15. Consequently, some regard this year as the war's official end. Others maintain that the conflict truly reached its conclusion only with the establishment of the Civilization Band in Talosian Calendar, Year 17.

findings.name: The Foundation
findings.text:
ACCESS AUTHORITY LEVEL: 8

OPTICAL ID: Not provided as access has Authority Level 8 clearance

BUG/WIRE SCAN: Passed

FILE CATEGORY: 302

Pursuant to the Endfield SOW Security Protocol for Key and Sensitive Intelligence, please confirm the following facts before perusing any intel related to "The Foundation":

1. The Foundation is a collection of unique individual entities that have mastered the legacy of the Precursor Civilization. Their existence itself is a part of the said legacy.

2. The Foundation launched a full-scale attack on the Terran Joint Science Expedition and triggered the First Aggeloi War. The Foundation has made its hostile intent to destroy and subjugate Terran Civilization irrevocably clear.

3. The Foundation is the creator of Ankhors and Aggeloi, but these two entities are but the most basic "tools" of the Foundation. The true creations of the Foundation are far more dangerous than these crude constructs.

4. During Talosian Calendar Year 15, the Endministrator and Forty Heroes achieved a decisive victory in the North Pole. The victory eliminated the threat posed by the Foundation and proved crucial in ending the First Aggeloi War.
findings.unlock: Progress through the main mission Chapter II Process VII: Stubbornly Lingers the Setting Sun

findings.name: Tianshi Bureau Academy
findings.text:
The Tianshi Bureau Academies (TBA) are academic and research institutions established by the Affiliated Hongshan Academy of Sciences of Tianshi Bureau of Great Yan (also known as Hongshan Academy of Sciences, or HAS). They are usually located in scientific developmental districts that have reached a sufficient size or level of development. Thanks to the joint efforts of TBAs across various districts, the HAS is able to sustain rapid research and development in every field of science.

The responsibilities of the TBAs include pursuing various scientific research projects and training more Tianshi for the HAS and the Civilization Band. The title of Tianshi carries a very special meaning in Ancient Yanese, but in Talos-II, a Tianshi is simply an official scientific or technical personnel of the HAS.

The role of a Tianshi carries on the legacy of Yanese traditions and is divided into various disciplines. Unlike the Tianshi of Terra, the Tianshi of Talos-II focus on survival and crises faced by the Civilization Band. These differences are the reason why the TBAS of Talos-II no longer restrict their admissions to disciples of Yanese descent. Anyone who can prove their worth to the HAS will be able to study and conduct scientific research at the TBA.

findings.name: United Workers' Syndicates of Talos II (UWST)
findings.text:
The United Workers' Syndicates of Talos II (UWST) is the largest union of self-governing worker syndicates on Talos-II. It believes in the guiding law where quantitative change will transform into qualitative change. The UWST is the manufacturer of most industrial and mining machinery, facilities, and tools used on the planet. It is also the undisputed leader of raw materials and resource production in the new world.

The history of the UWST dates back to the Age of Terra. UWST crew mates actively participated in the frontiering of Talos-II and were the very first organization to reach the new world. The UWST provided detailed and professional work planning as well as brutish yet extremely powerful fleets of machinery that were essential and instrumental during the Early Phase Expansions across Talos-II and the Rebuilding after the First Aggeloi War.

The UWST of today seems hampered by its ever-growing yet inflexible organization, but they continue to cling to the UW spirit. The United Workers symbolize humanity's "construction" and "expansion" efforts. With the support of precision logistics from the Talos-II General Chamber of Commerce (TGCC) and powerful new technologies provided by the Hongshan Academy of Sciences (HAS), the UWST continues to churn out one forward base after another from the gargantuan yards of their Industrial Mothership — Mat' Gorodov. After all, the UWST is the engine that drives the expansion of the human frontier.

findings.name: Utjug Order
findings.text:
The Utjug Order is a special mobilization mechanism the UWST activates under extreme combat conditions to deploy military resources.

The Utjug Order's activation systems, deployed across various regions, typically consist of signal emitters and beacon devices. Specially designed signal emitters contain two authorization keycards, each entrusted to different senior field commanders of the UWST at the location. Only when both keycards are used simultaneously can communication coordinates be successfully transmitted.

When the signal emitter activates, the UWST receives the Utjug Order. As one of the UWST's highest strategic commands, recipients automatically assume the transmission source is undergoing catastrophic military assault. Any UWST installation receiving this directive will unconditionally deploy military resources toward the signal's origin.

Upon receiving coordinates, the UWST Warzone Command conducts a voice verification. If no response is detected, they initiate saturated military resource deployment. Should the response confirm specific combat parameters, they execute precision deployment of military assets to designated locations accordingly.
findings.unlock: Progress through the main mission Chapter I Process IV: Scaldings of Utjug

findings.name: UWST Security Bureau
findings.text:
The Security Bureau of the UWST serves as the internal department responsible for domestic security, external intelligence, special environment investigations, and monitoring compliance with the Band Accord treaties.

If you ask UWST workers "When would you see Security Bureau personnel?" you would receive three distinct answers based on generational differences. The youngest workers would say they've scarcely encountered them, only hearing about their routine visits to production bases to verify the safety of personnel and resources. Middle-aged veterans would recount how during major expansion projects, Bureau agents always participated in onsite committees to prevent external interference with operations.

The most senior workers might share a lingering rumor from earlier times. They speak of the Bureau's establishment one afternoon when the scent of blood still hung heavy in the air, not long after that inglorious war concluded. The blood on their hands secured the Union's safety and stability to this day, while ensuring any voices contradicting the Band Accord's principles vanished into the shadows of back alleys.
findings.unlock: Complete the main mission Chapter I Process III: Park Way Party

findings.name: Valley IV
findings.text:
Valley IV is a frontier production region chosen by the UWST. It is located along the fringes of the Civilization Band.

When the Aggeloi War finally ended, humanity made plans to push the frontiers further across the world. The UWST directed its focus at Valley IV due to the rich mineral wealth of the region. With the support of Endfield Industries, the UWST began various construction projects in Valley IV. Following the completion of various quarries, mines, and production bases, the UWST began deploying research facilities to pursue energy-related R&D projects such as applied Originium technology and Originium cultivation in Valley IV.

The UWST had high hopes and expectations for their Valley IV venture. However, a disastrous accident deprived Valley IV of its Great Originium Oak and the UWST became more circumspect in its future endeavors. Fortunately, Endfield has recently expanded the Hub Base site in Valley IV for carrying out Techno-Protocol testing and production of Protocol facilities. In essence, Endfield investments is currently keeping the Valley IV economy afloat.

findings.name: Wuling
findings.text:
The Wuling region serves as a focal area of Hongshan Academy of Sciences (HAS) for its Blight control initiatives. The Wuling Scientific Developmental District has been established in this region.

The Tianshi of the Hongshan Academy of Sciences (HAS) — scholars who mastered the Originium Arts and carry on the Yanese traditions of research and learning — are determined to change the fate of this land.

Following the First Aggeloi War, the massive Blight rift in the Wuling region (Wuling Very Large Rift) became one of the Civilization Band's most pressing challenges. This deep geological rupture spans the entire territory, representing the largest documented Æther rift within known Band boundaries. Blight spreading from the rift's epicenter has caused severe environmental degradation, transforming natural water systems into liquid Blight. The contamination zone continues expanding outward, demonstrating persistent territorial advancement over time.

In Talosian Calendar, Year 132, a research delegation from HAS was stationed in the Wuling region to develop Xiranite materials for environmental restoration. After two decades of research and construction, achieved through tremendous sacrifice, the Tianshi Pillar Array enabled dynamic containment of Blight Tides within limited geographical boundaries. While HAS has accomplished remarkable achievements in the Wuling region from the Civilization Band's perspective, the complete remediation of this fractured landscape remains a distant goal.
findings.unlock: Complete the main mission Chapter II Process I: Destination Wuling

findings.name: Wuling City
findings.text:
Wuling City serves as a key Hongshan Academy of Sciences (HAS) research base within the Wuling Scientific Developmental District, functioning as the region's sole major urban habitat.

Wuling City stands as the foremost frontier for monitoring Æther activities and studying rifts and Blight environments, serving both HAS and the entire Civilization Band. The city's most distinctive features are its arrays of Tianshi Pillars and ubiquitous hydraulic infrastructure. Its population primarily consists of HAS Tianshi, farmers, laborers, and their families.

Wuling City originated as a Science Station established in Talosian Calendar, Year 132 by HAS to advance the Comprehensive Management Project for the Wuling Very Large Rift. Initially staffed by just 113 Tianshi and laborers, the Station gradually expanded to accommodate over a thousand residents following the development of Xiranite technology and the initiation of comprehensive environmental surveys of the rift, alongside the construction of prototype Xiranite forges.

In Talosian Calendar, Year 142, attempts to contain the main body of the Very Large Rift ended in disaster. A massive Blight disaster swallowed the Science Station, resulting in significant casualties. This tragedy became the foundation upon which Wuling City would rise. HAS Tianshi, farmers, and laborers refused to abandon the comprehensive management project. New Xiranite technological breakthroughs, fresh infrastructure initiatives, advanced hydraulic control systems, and ultimately a new city emerging beside the disaster's ruins, collectively formed what we now know as Wuling City.
findings.unlock: Progress through the main mission Chapter II Process I: A Glance of Astonishment

findings.name: Wuling Very Large Rift (Wuling VLR)
findings.text:
The Wuling Very Large Rift is a colossal Blight fissure located beneath the Wuling region, representing the largest documented Blight fracture within the known territories of the Civilization Band.

The Wuling Very Large Rift manifests geographically as a network of massive fissures, comprising an extremely active central fracture with branch systems extending dozens of kilometers. Since being documented by the Civilization Band, the fracture's Blight phenomena have penetrated and shattered the region's deep geological structures. Groundwater transformed into liquid Blight by the fracture periodically surges to the surface, creating disastrous events known as "Blight Tides".

In Talosian Calendar, Year 142, the Tianshi at Wuling Science Station attempted to sever the connection between the central rift and its branch systems using Xiranite, hoping to contain the fissure's expansion. Despite meticulous preparation, the operation triggered disastrous consequences. Within two hours, both the science station and prototype Xiranite facilities were completely consumed by Blight tides. The disaster site, now known as the North Wuling Exclusion Zone, remains an unhealed scar on Wuling City's landscape. While the Tianshi Pillar Array has effectively controlled liquid Blight in the region, HAS Tianshi understand the ever-expanding Very Large Rift could unleash another disastrous tide at any moment, threatening to submerge the entire territory once more.
findings.unlock: Progress through the main mission Chapter II Process I: Arrival at Wuling

findings.name: Xiranite
findings.text:
Xiranite represents a groundbreaking material developed for Blight containment, standing as one of HAS's primary research achievements within the Wuling Scientific Developmental District.

Xiranite emerged from HAS's comprehensive management project in the Wuling region. Upon arrival, the Tianshi of the HAS scientific survey team discovered the area's complex hydrogeography and widespread fracture networks primarily manifested as liquid Blight. Conventional large-scale rift containment methods from the Civilization Band, layering Originium isolation barriers from periphery to epicenter, proved unsuitable here. Consequently, they pioneered an alternative approach: leveraging the Academy's unique expertise in Feranmut studies to develop entirely new solutions.

In Talosian Calendar, Year 140, through the collaborative efforts of multiple Tianshi and a Feranmut Proxy, a new Originium-based material named Xiranite was successfully developed. Repeated independent testing confirmed that activated Xiranite could gradually neutralize liquid Blight into natural water through self-sacrificial consumption. As project partners, Endfield Industries participated in constructing the prototype Xiranite facilities. Today, the Tianshi Pillar Arrays and large-scale water purification projects established over the Wuling Very Large Rift have created a stabilized zone, achieving dynamic containment over the disastrous Blight Tides.
findings.unlock: Progress through the main mission Chapter II Process I: Arrival at Wuling

findings.name: Xiranite Nexus
findings.text:
The Xiranite Nexus is one of the many experimental Originium devices developed and constructed by the Hongshan Academy of Sciences (HAS) to contain the Wuling Very Large Rift (Wuling VLR). This device is a key achievement of scientific research conducted by the HAS in the Wuling Scientific Developmental District, and it uses sudden emissions of Xiranite energy that react with Æther energy to seal the Rift.

After the large-scale Blight disaster in Talosian Calendar Year 142, the Wuling Scientific Developmental District reported shortages in its Xiranite reserves. Tianshi Zhuang Fangyi led the Novel Xiranite-Based Materials Project, which included Xiranite Nexus development. However, after multiple rounds of iterations that failed to deliver the desired results, the development of Xiranite Nexus was temporarily suspended. The project then shifted its focus to upgrading Xiranite production and constructing the Tianshi Pillar Array instead.

Although Xiranite Nexus development was put on hold, the Tianshi remained hopeful. In Talosian Calendar Year 152, support from Endfield Industries helped alleviate the crisis caused by limited Xiranite production yields. Xiranite Nexus development was then restarted to seek a permanent solution for the threat posed by the Wuling VLR.
findings.unlock: Complete the main mission Chapter II Process VI: A Breach Starts with a Crack

findings.name: Yan
findings.text:
Yan is an ancient empire located in the eastern parts of Terra. It is a vast and populous country well known for its long history.

Yan boasts robust public healthcare and education systems as well as a stable and safe society. For many years, Yan maintained a largely isolationist and peaceful stance, actively refraining from interfering in the affairs of other nations. Yanese messengers and Tianshi, authorized by imperial edicts, would only leave the borders and engage in diplomacy when an emergency made this approach the only resort.

Yan's head of state is the Emperor, who also bears the title of "True Lung". The vast empire is governed by the imperial court centralized administrative collective comprising the Emperor, the Cabinet, and the Six Ministries (Personnel, Revenue, Rites, War, Justice, and Works) — as well as a bureaucracy that extends into every administrative division of Yan. Operating under the Six Ministries are specialized state organs, including the Imperial Astronomers and the Sui Regulator, the latter of which is charged with monitoring the fragments of the Feranmut Sui and thus possesses vast knowledge related to the Feranmuts. Those who serve within this organization are known as Candleholders. The Sui Regulator continues to play a crucial role in scientific research and development at the Hongshan Academy of Sciences on Talos-II.

Yan's powerful military is the main reason the country is respected by its neighbors. Among its armed forces, the Imperial Guards are the most powerful and elite formation. They serve as guardians of the True Lung, protectors of the core interests and order of the empire, and supreme executors of the will of the Yanese nation. The selection process for the Imperial Guards is extremely strict, and every Imperial Guard is a formidable combatant. Under the Yanese political system, the Imperial Guards represent an "unshakable order" and their mere presence imposes a powerful deterrent. The Imperial Guards of Talos-II, however, pale in scale when compared to their Terran counterpart. Their mission and composition have also undergone various changes.

findings.name: Yinglung Pass
findings.text:
Yinglung Pass is a massive collection of lockdown facilities constructed by the Hongshan Academy of Sciences (HAS) to deal with the Wuling Very Large Rift (VLR) rupture event. The Pass, once part of the peripheral Blight monitoring facilities of Wuling Science Station, is located atop a natural chasm in the region of Wuling. When first completed, it was named "Wuling Pass". After subsequent overhauls and expansions, and deployment of an Yinglung Special Task Force garrison, the HAS renamed the defense works as "Yinglung Pass".

The main architecture of Yinglung Pass was designed by Tumu Tianshi of the HAS. The Tianshi incorporated Xiranite material technology. To contain VLR growth, the defensive structure was further reinforced with Blight-countering features. All design and construction standards were based on a hypothetical scenario of another VLR rupture event. If necessary, the HAS will further augment the defensive capacities of Yinglung Pass by committing its best emergency response forces and employing Feranmut Power.

For ten years, the YSTF garrison at Yinglung Pass has upheld the duties of monitoring, surveying, and eliminating Blight phenomena within the North Wuling Exclusion Zone (North Wuling EZ). The YSTF is also responsible for enacting rapid response measures against any contingency in the Yinglung Pass area.

As of today, Yinglung Pass has stood vigil at the boundary of the North Wuling EZ for ten years.
findings.unlock: Progress through the main mission Chapter II Process VII: Bravely Breach the Hostile Winds

findings.name: Yinglung Special Task Force
findings.text:
Yinglung Special Task Force (YSTF) is an elite combat unit serving under Hongshan Academy of Sciences (HAS). The unit is responsible for carrying out the highest levels of special combat operations.

The founding of YSTF is compliant with the general principle provided in the Band Accord, where all Accord signatories are given the right to establish and maintain a military force for defending the entirety of the Civilization Band. In Talosian Calendar Year 23, a senior Candleholder under the Sui Regulator of Yan selected and trained the first cohort of YSTF members (colloquially referred to as Yinglungs) from among Yanese veterans of the First Aggeloi War. HAS generously provided the Yinglungs with advanced Yanese technologies that survived the war. Yinglungs are equipped with Feranmut artifacts and gear modified by the Tianshi, allowing them to wield varying degrees of Feranmut power. They are also one of the very few special forces capable of carrying out extended operations in environments severely affected by the Blight.

An Yinglung squad is currently garrisoned at the Wuling Scientific Developmental District for long-term combat operations. These Yinglungs have established multiple sentry bases throughout Wuling. Their primary objectives include: conducting regular deep forays into the North Wuling Exclusion Zone for forward monitoring; deploying Xiranite devices to contain Blight activities; and neutralizing major threats to the security of Wuling City.
