findings.name: Murder of a Landbreaker
findings.text:
Greetings, Endministrator.

With the assistance of operator Wulfgard, we have completed a comprehensive analysis of the Landbreaker attack sites in Valley IV. Below is our summary:

After thorough evaluation, we confirm these incidents were orchestrated as "internal purges". A nimble, cunning slayer, using ambushes, deception, and minimal effort, eliminated designated targets with chilling efficiency.

According to operator Wulfgard, the attacker, codenamed "Shadow", is likely Brenna of the Bonekrusher Clan, a ruthless individual with bloodstained hands. Rumors suggest that after the clan's consolidation, she challenged Nefarith and suffered a crushing defeat. Yet, instead of executing her, Nefarith integrated Brenna into her ranks, a decision now justified by the precision of the attacks.

Victims like "Guillotine" and "Will-o-Wisp" died invoking "Volcano's" name, while "Bloodeye" was found holding an invitation from "Volcano". Clearly, "Volcano" aimed to rally dissidents to overthrow Nefarith. What he didn't anticipate? "Shadow", or Brenna, was never his ally. Nefarith wielded her like a blade, effortlessly excising traitors.

Betrayal and bloodshed are routine for them. But after collaborating
with Wulfgard, we uncovered a critical commonality: all victims operated on the fringes of Nefarith's so-called "blessings".

"Guillotine" Gabbi: A mercenary at heart, served numerous masters. His loyalty to the clan was always questionable.

"Will-o-Wisp" Vichir: An elite Bonekrusher Pyromancer. Since Jakub's era, such specialists have relied on traditional raiding tactics. Their adherence to old ways made them resistant to change.

"Bloodeye" Sazaro: Led a tight-knit elite group. Such cohesion often
becomes a barrier during transitions.

"Volcano" Chacha: Every clue reflects suppressed rage and hatred. Operator Wulfgard also updated us with a piece of intel. Chacha's grandfather served the warlord Jakub back in those days as a personal enforcer. This, together with Chacha's chat records, reveal the "Volcano" to be a stubborn and extremist supporter of the "orthodoxy".

Their attempted rebellion was, in essence, the "old" Bonekrusher Clan resisting Nefarith's new order. Their failure signals the purge of "outdated elements" from the evolving clan.

Nefarith has proven to be a shrewd ruler. She not only grips her clan's ideology but also anticipates the fallout of her rapid rise, hence orchestrating these attacks in Valley IV to lure dissenters into a trap. Moreover, her influence extends beyond the clan: "Volcano's" hoped-for external support was severed before it materialized, proving her roots already reach deep into the Civilization Band (investigations regarding the "corporation" mentioned in the letter are underway).

The Bonekrusher Clan's instability is currently advantageous for us, but this may be temporary.

findings.name: IR: "Tide Flayer" Project
findings.text:
Endministrator, we have acquired read access for the files you submitted. With the authorization granted by the Wuling Institute of Materials Science, we acquired and archived test reports and records associated with the Tide Flayer project. This project was an attempt to utilize high-density Xiranite to address the Blight. The details are as follows:

FILE NUMBER: 147

PROJECT TITLE: Tide Flayer

PRIMARY INVESTIGATOR: Mo Hen

PRINCIPLES AND CONCEPTS: Given the instability of Blight and Blight-related materials, the location of the Blight Core cannot be discerned with the means and conditions available to this project. Algorithmic offsets and deviations are also too large to achieve effective Xiranite filling and coverage. Hence, this test opted to compress super-dense Xiranite into a whip-like structure. Upon contact with the Blight Core, this structure rapidly disintegrates, releasing Xiranite at the point of contact. This achieves efficient broad-area probing, positioning, and destruction of the Blight Core, thereby eliminating the threat posed by the Blight.

TESTING CONDITIONS: The Tide Flayer project requires investigators to be in close proximity to Blighted environments to perform detailed testing of whip probing ranges and Xiranite- release efficiency. Protective gear and Xiranite are to be supplied by the Institute of Materials Science. All testing must be conducted under the highest level of supervision.

PROJECT REVIEW RESULTS: Recommend complete suspension of this project

REVIEWER: Wuling Institute of Materials Science

findings.name: Infra-Station Search and Rescue Brief
findings.text: Based on all available intelligence: remaining supplies, intel from the Landbreakers, anomalous signals briefly captured by receivers, and on-site logs, it is highly probable that the three missing workers possess strong survival instincts and organizational skills. The absence of remains, intact devices prior to signal loss, and lack of engagement with Landbreakers suggest they likely severed their own tracking signals to avoid endangering the team or revealing their position. All evidence indicates a significant probability of survival. Immediate targeted search and rescue operations are recommended.

findings.name: Fangxing Avenue
findings.text:
Endministrator! We received the data!

I'll try to find a replacement terminal capable of communing smells as well. Perhaps the smells won't be enough. I wonder if there's a handyterm capable of physically delivering snacks from the shopping avenue... Okay. I must conclude the usual greetings and start data analysis if I wish to avoid the wrath of my team leader. We have verified the following intel regarding the history of the Wuling shopping avenue that you are interested in.

First, we are certain that Fangxing Avenue of Wuling is a wonder that cannot be replicated elsewhere.

I believe you already have the basic understanding of the Very Large Rift (VLR). The huge formation of multiple rifts measures nearly one hundred kilometers in length and exists right below Wuling. In other words, the city is literally built on an "active volcano" — To be more accurate, the entire place is built right over a "volcanic crater". So, why would such a precarious city develop such a bustling shopping avenue? Why is everyone settling in with a peace of mind...? We checked past records about Wuling and arrive at these verified findings — The Viceroy Tianshi Zhuang Fangyi has exceptional administrative skills. Ever since the founding of Wuling, she wholly focused on providing living amenities, education, and business opportunities. Her comprehensive ideas and approach are most admirable. Of course, I am not downplaying the contributions of the Wulingers... According to verifiable data we have, Tianshi Zhuang always came up with the most applicable development plans for special focuses that require them most. These efforts include the adding new bamboo raft stops, or introducing new Chubby Lung designs for Fangxing Avenue... I believe every Wulinger (though this claim appears exaggerated, it is not) has placed their trust in her for the city to reach its present day level of development. You yourself read the memos of the traveling merchant or the proprietor... Everyone inside and outside the city believes that the shopping avenue is heading up. A commercial wonder in a precipitous place. I believe this is the impression that people get when they first visit Fangxing Avenue.

Experience this place at your own leisure. You have left quite a mark on Wuling, and I am sure everyone is honored to be in your presence.

findings.name: Transport in Jingyu Valley
findings.text:
Endministrator, we received the data you have uploaded.

The bamboo of Wuling is incredibly famous!

Ah! The topic is about something else... Apologies... I'll now answer your inquiries about transportation in Wuling.

From the data you sent us, writings that mention becoming "lost" or other overt signs of psychological trauma exhibited by travelers in the Stragglers Grove are ... undoubtedly exaggerated.

According to existing data in the database, we can identify two key features in the design of transportation in Wuling — nature and order. "Nature" literally refers to lack of abrupt, artificial structures in Jingyu Valley, and that includes roads, bamboo raft stops, and even the pantailbeast: lair mentioned by the forest ranger indicated by the data you found. However, Jingyu Valley remains a rather a place.

"Order", on the other hand, might be a little hard to describe. I encourage you to explore and experience the area in person. Taking a raft ride through Jingyu Valley might be a start. How about using our Endfield ziplines? You will discover that the Wulingers have established a decent transport network throughout Jingyu Valley with minimal disruption to the natural landscape. Such an achievement requires incredible skills in area planning.

Perhaps the well-established Yanese tradition of fengshui produced new blossoms in the distant world of Talos-ll? Try looking for additional information, if the opportunity presents itself.

findings.name: Aggelos
findings.text:
Endmin, you have made significant contributions. All the intel files uploaded to Dijiang have been safely archived.

We can draw the following conclusions: What we deemed impossible has actually happened.

Let's start with the files you recovered. We verified them against Aggelos-related clue dossiers of Valley IV gathered over the years. We can be certain that no anomalous states existed amongst the Aggeloi created in Valley IV for several decades. To some degree, the random Ankhorfalls and super aggressive Aggeloi can be treated as a manifestation of that particular "system" (although the signals were weak and barely detectable). In fact, the incident is congruent with our understanding of the "Aggeloid" phenomenon that stood true for 150 years. And since the Aggeloi is a phenomenon and not an evolving or changing lifeform (though individual mutations and variants have been observed), Aggelos activities of Valley IV reported so far rest within our normal expectations.

However, you have personally experienced the Incursion of Valley IV itself as well as its repercussions. We, together with our allies, have all made unambiguous observations of Aggeloi and humans attacking a single target as a united force. Or to put simply, humanity has "fought alongside" the Aggeloi. This is theoretically improbable as we have long treated the weak Aggeloid signals (that we believe are used by the Aggeloi for communicating with each other) to be completely undecipherable, even when we applied the algorithmic engines of that particular "system" all those years ago. Our attempts to commune with the Aggeloi or to render them harmless have also failed.

Endministrator, no matter what Nefarith, her Landbreakers, or even the Aggeloi have in mind, we must do everything we can to stop their next move. Everyone at the Intel Office believes you are well prepared for this.

findings.name: Qingbo Stockade
findings.text:
Endmin, we received the data you uploaded.

I understand your desire to learn more about the building of Qingbo Stockade. It is indeed a topic that we should look deeper into. In fact, we were prepared to analyze Qingbo Stockade when news of your arrival at that location reached Dijiang. A database search was initiated at once. Unfortunately, we received very few hits. Even our SOW database contains very little information about the construction of Qingbo Stockade (however, this does not mean we lack understanding on the current status of Qingbo Stockade; regarding information on the region of Wuling, we have already conferred with the Hongshan Academy of Sciences for a timely update in an appropriate manner).

Fortunately, you have also acquired new findings. Through our analysis, we can say with certainty that the building of Qingbo Stockade went through at least two important phases. The first phase involved the elimination of nearby threats, which were likely to be packs of beasts that roamed the area... However, this does not mean that the Blight or Aggeloi posed less of a risk. The local fauna of Qingbo Stockade may have once endangered the livelihood of the local residents to a degree that goes beyond our imagination. The rakerbeasts, howlwerbeasts, and waterlamps you have encountered strongly suggest this possibility. Meanwhile, evidence has been in the database about an Aldertone of the Hannabit Circuit who visited Wuling over 80 years ago. The hanna folksong he left behind includes this line: "An ocean of beasts, a source of the creeks." We were uncertain what the hanna meant until you uploaded your findings. The song is now solid proof how Qingbo Stockade was once threatened by beasts. We postulate that beast taming techniques were developed by Stockaders who tried to fight against these bestial hazards.

Phase two of that building of Qingbo Stockade is probably related to environmental engineering. After reading through the writings and records of the sketcher you uploaded, we also checked ambient readings synced with us when you deployed the Sub-PAC. Our analysis revealed that the overall architectural design of Qingbo Stockade was rather similar to outpost expansion during a certain period in our history. Shortly after the First Aggeloi War ended, researchers proposed many plans for building small outposts. These designs focused on maximizing the use of local topography, adapting to the local environments, and low-cost construction methods to intercept, channel, and divert Blight masses... Qingbo Stockade happens to match this approach. "Water cascades from the heavens above" may seem like an esoteric line, but Qingbo Stockade actually lives up to this name with its high-rise buildings. We can assume, with good reason, that individual knowledgeable in such architectural approaches lived amongst the Stockaders during that time.

In essence, the building Qingbo Stockade can be treated as a historical montage about humanity's struggles to survive on Talos-II. It is something that everyone should remember. We thank you for your discoveries, Endministrator.

findings.name: Nightmares from the Past
findings.text:
Endmin, we have received, organized, and analyzed the documents you gathered from the Origin Lodespring. We can currently confirm that the crew mates were referring to the giant Aggelos that attacked Valley IV 20 years ago.

Astarron is the name we gave this Aggelos that attacked Valley IV. Its specifications and data were lost during the war. But now we can confirm that this entity was at least 100 meters in height. It was called the Astarron as it resembled crude rock paintings of the sun made during ancient times in Terra. Astarron featured over a thousand "spokes" that twist and rotate like a great circular vortex. When Astarron advanced, it covered the land with an ominous shade of dark red generated by the Æther flowing in its immense form, a deathly zone for all living beings within. Due to the loss of video and other surveillance data, we could hardly imagine how the UWST felt when they faced Astarron 20 years ago. Nevertheless, the crew emerged victorious from this battle.

The special macro-formation of Originium clusters known as the Great Originium Oak was used as a weapon when the Valleyfolk fought against Astarron. But how did they do it? Did they simply use the Oak as a bomb? The explosive yield of that amount of Originium would have completely devastated the whole of Valley IV... I know this should not be something I'm supposed to ask, but our database only contains the most basic of data about the Great Originium Oak. You probably know more about this Originium formation ... but your memories...

Lastly and most importantly, be cautious, Endmin. Rumors and stories whispered by the crew mates about the Aggelos may not be completely unfounded. Many dangers and hostile entities may be buried under the Origin Lodespring. You might run into something that should have died in the past.

findings.name: Marker Stone Area
findings.text:
Endministrator, we received the data you have uploaded. We shall sync you with our findings about the Marker Stone.

The Marker Stone is the first, and the largest, Tianshi Pillar ever built. Thanks to SOW data and discourse with Tianshi Zhuang Fangyi, you likely have acquired a basic understanding of its designs, construction, and ability to weaken the Blight. This investigation report (IR) will therefore expand upon the operational mechanics and processes of the Marker Stone and its affiliated facilities.

First, we are certain that the outsider who made these notes was remarkably intelligent. This observant individual keenly identified the feature of the Marker Stone construction project that most warrants investigation: its deep integration with the aquatic environment. The entire Marker Stone and its nearby facilities are actually arranged in a way that resembles a multi-tiered terrace. We can divide this "terrace" into three portions based on the installation's purpose of suppressing the Very Large Rift (VLR): (1) the resistance portion; (2) the buffer portion; and (3) the central processing portion. The "resistance portion" naturally refers to the Marker Stone itself, a gigantic Tianshi Pillar with Xiranite coursing through it. This portion is capable of creating a boundary that contains the Blight. The "buffer portion", as the repair personnel's memo suggests, would be the water stored within the Reservoir Station. The buffer essentially helps to buy Wuling time for activating its emergency measures. If something were to happen to the resistance portion, the affected body of water would be directed to the third portion, namely the central processing portion. This portion has active Xiranite particles scattered within it (which you probably could not observe directly in the Marker Stone area), allowing it to immediately treat Blight-affected water. In addition to the designs of these three portions, the Marker Stone is also furnished with underwater defenses. The Aggeloi of Wuling tend to lurk within water bodies. To prevent the Marker Stone from being damaged, the installation also boasts a comprehensive suite of aquatic defenses (unfortunately, this is also not directly observable from your perspective). A great deal of effort must have been invested to construct this terraced installation. From the data that Hongshan Academy of Sciences (HAS) synced with us, we have learned how the Wulingers prepared for the construction of the Marker Stone in the Year 143. They started by excavating a Blight- breaking belt before moving on to sealing the local aquifers and furnishing the area with underwater defenses to defeat Aggelos attacks. Marker Stone construction was completed with incredible speed.

The construction of the Marker Stone can thus be considered a miracle. The installation itself is a symbol of hope.

findings.name: The Bonekrusher Clan
findings.text:
Endmin, thank you for the data you collected. For years, our knowledge of the Bonekrushers had been extremely limited. Old data about this clan were half-truths and fantasies based upon rumors and scout reports. First-hand information from actual Bonekrushers will help us learn more about Landbreaker communities to better elucidate their behaviors and determine their goals and modus operandi.

We have used these valuable pieces of intel to postulate the background and process that propelled the Bonekrusher Clan to power. During last winter, the north of the frontiers suffered the worst economic crisis and famine for several decades. The suffering was further compounded by Blight events and forced many Landbreaker clans to fight each other. The declining Bonekrushers suddenly came to power, swallowing up weaker clans as they snowballed into a massive army.

A strange form of flame known as "hazefyre" is crucial behind sudden rise of the Bonekrushers. Hazefyre seems related to the Blight. In addition to its hallucinogenic properties and neural toxicity, those who inhale it can receive a temporary spike in physiological performance. The Bonekrushers were able to create a stronger and more permanent Landbreaker clan that revolves around "hazefyre". And their chief, Nefarith, happens to be the one who introduced it to them.

Nefarith seems to have appeared out of the blue. We know nothing about her background, place of birth, life, personality, or beliefs. However, we are certain of this one thing: She deeply resents every faction she encounters. This individual has deliberately indoctrinated the Landbreakers with extreme fanaticism and hatred to encourage attacks on the Civilization Band. With victorious raids, plundered riches, and captured slaves, she further secured the loyalty of her followers.

There are 2 conventional strategies for an external force to strike at the LB: (1) unleash powerful attacks to neutralize key LB leadership and induce disintegration of the clan and; (2) diplomacy, trade, and bribery to reduce their hostilities. However, we neither have the means to take out the entire LB leadership nor enough resources to secure a lasting truce. As long as brutal warfare and other factors massively affecting survivability still exist, the number of LBS will only continue to grow and fuel the emergence of yet another clan like the Bonekrushers.

Perhaps the Civilization Band may give us a true solution for the Landbreaker Problem in the future.

findings.name: Yanese Ruins of Sword Vault Dale
findings.text:
Greetings, Endministrator. We received the data you uploaded and saw your questions regarding the Yanese ruins in Sword Vault Dale. The content herein is the results of our analysis.

First, we must be honest and admit our limitations. Given the impact of the First Aggeloi War and subsequent events, our database contains hardly any information on these Yanese ruins. This means our analysis will be speculative, albeit based on various perspectives. The content of this investigation report should only be accepted if it is congruent with the actual findings in the field.

From the information you recovered, we postulate that these ruins were constructed many years ago, circa the early phases after the outbreak of the First Aggeloi War. For an exact date, we will need you to gather physical samples from the ruins for a chronological analysis aboard Dijiang. Imagine this. In the early days of the First Aggeloi War, a team with an extremely high level of Protocol authority and supervision was ordered to go southwards. They endured all manner of danger, paid a dear price, and reached a place far away from the battlefield just to construct this facility... Perhaps the Aggeloi or major Blight Tides came and turned it into ruins. We postulate that the residents of Qingbo Stockade may know something about these ruins. Unfortunately, if what we know about education and knowledge preservation in Qingbo Stockade is true, written records about this site may have been lost for a while.

Our attempt to analyze the content preserved within the ruins involves integrating pieces of relevant intel about Qingbo Stockade, data salvaged from recovered records of the Aggeloi War, as well as the architecture and state of preservation of said ruins. The origin of the entire effort is obviously related to past surveillance missions that explored Talos-II. To ensure that certain things would not be lost, the Terrans stored them in these ruins. Currently, we have yet to arrive at an effective conclusion regarding the stored content. After all, vaults or storage facilities lost during the Aggeloi War or Blight disasters discovered to date have yielded content or salvages mostly tied to engineering, weaponry, or the Originium Arts. These ruins might contain similar things, though field validation will be required.

These ruins have been sealed away for over a century. Our analysis would only dispel the dust that had settled with time. But you are at the very threshold of the facility, Endmin. We believe you have what it takes to restore it to its former glory.

findings.name: Origins of the Æther Test Site
findings.text:
Greetings, Endmin. I've received the materials you sent. I'll begin my analysis at once.

The naturally stable rift and the Æther Test Site are the two most mentioned phrases in the materials you recovered. This is rather expected. When we first received the said materials, we initially tried to verify if you had chanced upon classified UWST research documents given the complicated situation you were in. But our suspicions were misplaced. The materials you recovered are quite standard.

A naturally stable rift is located at the Power Plateau of Valley IV. Its presence sparked quite a discussion during the early days of development in Valley IV (the intensity of this discussion, however, did not exceed those pertaining to popular movies screened at the same time). The Valley IV rift is not the first naturally stable rift discovered by humanity, nor is the Æther Test Site the first facility built for the study of rifts (though the UWST constructed it to be larger than it appears from the outside)... When the Æther Test Site was first built, the facility became quite the center of attention. However, the UWST finally chose "Ætherside observations" as the primary focus of research for the Æther Test Site, and I am uncertain if this can be attributed to internal issues of the UWST when it comes to their choices of their scientific research.

I believe you are very well aware that the endeavor might very well be a futile chase. No one has successfully observed the Ætherside itself after all these years... And no one in the HAS nor TGCC would regard projects that attempt to make Ætherside observations seriously, much less set aside funding for them.

Of course, given the current circumstances, this does not make UWST innocent of conducting high risk experiments in the Æther Test Site. Should you discover more clues in your subsequent operations, we shall continue this analysis at the first notice.

findings.name: Yinglung Combat Record
findings.text:
Endministrator, all current data has been compiled. We can safely assume that the Yinglung Special Task Force (YSTF) Team led by Shore actually found the sword thrown by Alleikhreos two years ago. However, the said sword triggered the spread of Blight Miasma and trapped two YSTF teams deep within the exclusion zone (EZ). They failed to confirm the actual nature of the entity at the marked coordinates. Their only recourse was to contact the three other YSTF teams to return with the data.

The appearance of Blightshades and Blight Miasma suddenly severed their exit route. Shore then decided to turn around and head further into the EZ with Team Stern and plant all the Yinglung Pillars they carried with them. A landslide occurred shortly after Shore discovered the sword. Having witnessed it fall deeper into the gorge, Shore decided to track it on her own, record the relevant data, and approximate the location of the sword.

Of the teams charged with escorting the coordinates, only one managed to reach the site near the Designated Urban Area. However, this team also failed to exit the EZ following a Blightshade ambush. The coordinates were later recovered by another YSTF team assigned to a separate operation. Nevertheless, YSTF suspended additional surveillance operations due to the significant casualties suffered. The landslide also rendered follow- up surveillance of the recovered coordinates meaningless.

If they had made it out alive, our investigations into the truth of the EZ incident could have restarted two years ago... Nevertheless, the brave and selfless actions of the Yinglungs have helped us breach the Blight Miasma.

They deserve our deepest and most sincere respect.

findings.name: Yinglung Pass
findings.text:
Greetings, Endministrator. Your data uploads have been received. We shall sync you with our findings regarding Yinglung Pass.

We believe you have, via the information provided by SOW, gained a preliminary understanding of the designs, construction, and purposes of Yinglung Pass. Hence, this data sync shall primarily focus on the garrison of this installation.

Thanks to the data you have uploaded, we can now make the following deductions: The Yinglung Special Task Force (YSTF) is wholly responsible for the defenses of Yinglung Pass. However, the YSTF will require support from other personnel on matters that lie outside their defensive duties. Starting from this conclusion, we perused vast amounts of data and found out that the Hongshan Academy of Sciences (HAS) has, where necessary, authorized short-term residency for laborers or Tianshi who passed their background checks. You may have seen several Tianshi conducting research in this area to handle the threat posed by the Very Large Rift (VLR). Although the North Wuling Exclusion Zone (NWEZ) is more fitting for field research compared to Yinglung Pass, entering the NWEZ would be considered a suicidal act for most people. Yinglungs who periodically venture deep into the NWEZ could not carry many scientific instruments for safety considerations. Hence, the Tianshi were forced to conduct their scientific research in the relative safety of Yinglung Pass. Furthermore, the duration of their residency and the area of their field studies must undergo multiple rounds of review by HAS Headquarters. Any scientific process or task can only be conducted while accompanied by the members of the YSTF.

We are thankful for the information you have gathered regarding the locals near Yinglung Pass and their views of the YSTF. Prior to your findings, we knew little regarding the public image of the YSTF. Most of our intel on this subject matter comes from external observations or idle chatter from members of the public. In addition to the documents we have found and the information you have kindly shared, we can see that the residents of Wuling, particularly the survivors from the disaster that took place ten years ago, actively volunteered for Yinglung Pass transport missions and often prepared their own supplies for the YSTF. This shows that the Yinglungs have grassroots support, even though they have been strictly prohibited from accepting any donations from the public.

Endministrator, the following statement of mine may go beyond the scope of our intel analysis. Nevertheless, I believe both of us can arrive at this same assumption: The Yinglungs are not lone guardians who sacrifice themselves in silence. A great multitude of volunteers willing to offer their unconditional support stands behind them, and behind you as well.

findings.name: Disaster Victims' Attempts of Survival
findings.text:
Endministrator. we have received the field information vou have gathered regarding the survivors of the North Wuling Exclusion Zone (NWEZ) disaster. We shall svnc our analysis with vou.

Firstly, we must apologize for the delay in sending this investigation report (IR). The operator who reviewed the uploaded information could hardly start drafting the IR, as it involved a great number of casualties from the terrible incident that befell Wuling. Hence, we adopted a more complicated approach to data analysis and evaluation. Given our considerations regarding the scientific rigor of the said approach, the analytical scope of this IR shall be limited to field information that you have secured and has not yet (or has vet to be) archived by the official Wuling database.

Almost all of the information that you have uncovered at the Desianated Urban Area and Celestial Column was left behind by first-hand witnesses and victims of the disaster from ten vears ago. The contents therein describe how the trapped victims attempted to survive and escape the disintegrating Blight Miasma at the early stages of the disaster before full-scale initiation of SAR attempts Although the Blight Miasma "gradually" washed over the NWEZ, the early onset of the disaster "bisected" the old Science Station. Numerous masses of Miasma then emerged, swallowing up those who could not escape while leaving some trapped in isolated pockets of relative safety. Despite the lack of communications, these survivors did not give up their attempts to escape to safety. The information you found is probably from an old research lab working on solutions for combating the Blight Tide. The lab was once furnished with multiple Xiranite test production facilities, a number of which should still be "active" assuming the absence of other intervening factors. Several early Xiranite experiments focused on the "brute force and quantity" approach. One of the projects for combating the Blight Tide designed Xiranite construction materials used in the Quelltide Levee. The project lab was furnished with substantial Xiranite reserves and various test facilities that people used to help them survive the early stages of the disaster. The information you found also highlighted the decisiveness, perseverance, and professionalism of the Science Station personnel who managed to survive the initial onslaught. They attempted to re-establish communications and organize intellectual assets they could still access.

The Wuling incident is an accident that left people mentally scarred, even to this day. But we are certain that your NWEZ operation will lead people back to a land that was once hostile to all life. Making the place hospitable again will greatly alleviate their weeping wounds.

Humanity never shies from suffering. Such is our confidence.

findings.name: IR: Operational Model of the Snowy Forest
findings.text:
Endministrator. we received your data uploads while you were in the Snowy Forest. The following is our analysis.

First, we are certain that the "Operational Model" of the Snowy Forest is a topic worthy of in-depth analyses and investigations. That being said, instead of calling it "Operational Model", "Maintenance Model"" or "Design Model" might be more appropriate.

As you can see, the Snowy Forest evidently has an abnormal climate. Similar anomalous environmental pockets have been found across Talos-II. Examples include icefields in the desert or even a small patch of desert in a forest. Such phenomena have various causes. We are still acquiring, integrating, and analyzing various data for the Snowy Forest's formation (we can, with near certainty, cite Originium Arts as the cause, though further data evidence is required). Of course, this deficiency will not affect our analysis of its internal designs and modeling.

The Old Snowpriestess mentioned in the data you uploaded is definitely a genius. From our existing data, the Snowy Forest is located in a rather open area of warmer latitudes. However, the Snowpriestess made clever use of her Originium Arts to influence. or should we say, maintain the current (and anomalous) state of the Snowy Forest. With masses of obfuscating fog and pine trees, she has kept the Forest hidden from outsiders to keep it within a "closed and stable" state. Meanwhile. the maintainers of this system (which is to say, the witchcraft creations) she deployed are intricately designed. Said creations have the advantages of being structurally simple, easy to create, and cheap to maintain, as they are made out of wood, rocks, and mud. The creations themselves have also become an important component of this "closed and stable" state. Think of it this way. A witchcraft creation damaged beyond repair need only rest quietly by a trail, or beneath some snow. It would simply serve as an obstacle obscuring an outsider's field of view and become part of the Snowy Forest's many trails. Visiting outsiders might not even notice the presence of these guardians if they remained in their ideal state. Unfortunately, the absence of management due to the Snowpriestess's departure from the Forest made them increasingly "feral", resulting in their extreme levels of aggression.

A design that incorporates such life-like and natural cycles can only be achieved by one who has truly roamed the wildlands and is in tune with all living beings. We are willing to believe that the Old Snowpriestess is a kind and sensitive soul. Should you meet her face-to-face in the future, please convey to her our most sincere greetings and respect.

findings.name: IR: City of "Suiming"
findings.text:
Greetings, Endministrator. We have received the materials you have gathered and analyzed it at once.

From the records you provided and the story narrated by Mr. Yu Shigui, we can deduce that the city named "Suiming"' is rather different from the more usual types of human settlements found on Talos-II. Overall, Suiming would be closer to a large R&D complex that focused on Tianshi Pillar technologies. Most of the city buildings served R&D and/or data storage functions, while most city residents were scientists and their family members. Most of the scientists were migrants from other cities and a number of them never managed to return home.

Opinions differ regarding the causes of the major disaster mentioned in the story (which is likely to have referenced an actual incident). The majority believes that the disaster was caused by periodic fluctuations of the Blight Tide and an inadequately developed early warning system. However, a sizable number of researchers believe that the disaster struck the city because the Hongshan Academy of Sciences (HAS) lacked experience and countermeasures for handling contingencies of such a nature.

Suiming City itself may be a fictional city created by several novelists or storytellers based on hearsay and rumors of various HAS Scientific Developmental Districts. For example, the "permission for raising a city" is based on the founding of the Wuling Science Station near the Wuling Very Large Rift (VLR).

Thus, based on the aforementioned conclusions we have drawn, records of this city can be treated as a tale of fiction that is based on actual events. Treating the story as a reflection of the people's hope and desires when facing a sudden disaster, as well as a yearning for changing the past ... is perfectly understandable.

findings.name: Miscellany and Clever Records
findings.text:
A pugilist who measures the Band with fists.

A poet who brings life to the ages with fine kohl.

A chef who connects people with the ladle.

A farmer who sows the land with seeds.

A pair of twins who freely wander with steel and ink.

You see, such is the joy of Talos-II. I've never met those relatives of mine, yet these lands offer me traces that remind me of them.

There is no legacy between them and these traces I found. All of them are just pure coincidence, yet the perfectness of the fit gave me a sense of nostalgia. I actually felt their very existences.

Hence, I've gathered the records and kept them in the painting. When the mood comes, I'd just read the records again and satisfy that pressing urge.

Don't be mistaken. I'm not some stranded Feranmut Proxy orphan. Some of my siblings are here on Talos-II. Paying them a visit is extremely easy, especially given my powers.

But everyone is busy with everyday life, and a grown fowl chick has to flutter its wings and leave the nest. These rules apply to me as well.

I have the Si Regu Sui Regulator, a few Tianshi who I can chat with, and you. You are my personal links. And I believe my siblings have theirs.

Once I'm in the mood for it, and if the timing is right, our reunion will naturally happen.

When that day comes, you better be there.

So, having fun with the games I left you? Hanging around the scroll is very therapeutic for the mind, right? Great. Break's over. Go and save the world. Bet there are thousands of worried people waiting for you at Dijiang.

findings.name: Apparition Behavior
findings.text:
Endministrator, we received the data you uploaded.

I am happy to see that the content of these uploads neither involves serious issues nor somber history. You are exhausted and very much injured. It gladdens us to see that you managed to catch a break during the mission and secured a chance to appreciate the wonders of Talos-II.

You have started an investigation of Apparitions, objects animated by the powers of the Feranmut "Sui". We believe official data provided by SOW is more than sufficient: "There are also many forms of Apparitions. The most well-known are Ink Spirits created by the act of painting, and Waregeists, which are mundane objects and utensils imbued with the powers of Sui'." Such details would not be repeated here. Instead, this IR shall focus on Apparition behaviors and modi operandi, as well as various relevant witness reports on that said focus.

Apparitions naturally exhibit a wide variety of behaviors, but our existing information is unable to completely verify the underlving principles that govern said variety. Experts in Feranmut studies believe that the basic foundation of Apparition behavior is largely a gift from its creator, or in other words, its creator's idea and/or expectation on what it should become. However, the creator often created small or interesting Apparitions without a strong idea or deliberate intent in mind. Also, where the Apparition was once a tiny pool of ink or a worn object, its behavior might be influencec by its immediate environment or the people it comes into contact with.

Intel that Wuling shared with us contains this record: A Tube Professor (Protocol Datalogger), after being turned into an Apparition by the Proxy's influence, began wandering aimlessly around the streets of Wuling. When encountering patrolling watchguards, the Tube Professor started sharing AIC Factory know-hows, a verbose session that lasted several hours until the stores along the streets were about to open for business. Only then did the Tube Professor agree (with some hesitation) to leave with the Yinglungs who arrived to verify the encounter.

This incident showed that their behavioral patterns can be quite chaotic and unpredictable, and are extremely difficult to summarize. You have spent quite a while in the Painting and met plenty of Apparitions. Driven by their own spiritual essence, they were able to live and act according to their own will. Perhaps that is why they are such lovely things, aren't they?
